Thy attendants, Thy Ganas are very terrible; I bow down to Thee. Thou hast created different universes; salutations to Thee. Thou art the Creator of various worlds; Thou awardest rewards to \[good\] deeds; Salutations to Thee. Thou art the head of all; salutations to Thee. Thy eye is never destroyed. Thou art the enjoyer of sacrifices; Thou fulfillest the desires of the devotees and Thou removest away the attachment of this world; Salutations to Thee. My salutations to Thee of infinite forms, the most Wrathful, the One decorated with the crescent of the Moon and the magnanimous. Thy glory is immeasurable and Thou art adored by all; salutations to Thee. My salutations to the Rider of the bull, the Destroyer of Tripura, the Fulfilier of the dovotees’ ambitions, the great remedy of everyone’s troubles, the Lord of the Creation, the Greatest of the great, I am at Thy mercy. Thou art the Great Acharya, that is, teacher of the rules of conduct of all the beings, animate or inanimate; Thou art the Creator of all the beings Thou art great, dear, and immeasurable; Thou boldest the Moon on Thy forehead; I take refuge in Thee. Lord! Grant me back the life of Kama. None in the three worlds, excepting Thee, can restore Cupid to life. Thou art the Lord of the dear ones; Thou producest the dear ones Thou hast created all the objects high and low. Thou art the only Lord of the Universe. Thou dost seem to me the only Merciful. Thou art the Lord of the three worlds and Thou drivest away the fears of the devotees.

## \|\| 154.271 \|\|

*śaṃkara uvāca*  
*bhaviteti ca kāmo 'yaṃ kālātkānto 'cirādapi \|*  
*anaṅga iti lokeṣu sa vikhyātiṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 271 \|\|*

271\. Suta said: After Rati, the wife of Cupid, had thus prayed the Lord Shiva, the latter was greatly pleased and sweetly said:

## \|\| 154.272 \|\|

*ityuktā śirasāvandya giriśaṃ kāmavallabhā \|*  
*jagāmopavanaṃ ramyaṃ ratistu himabhūbhṛtaḥ \|\| 272 \|\|*

272\. Shankara said: — “Your husband will be born after a short time when He will be known as Ananga.”

## \|\| 154.273-274 \|\|

*ruroda cāpi bahuśo dīnā ramye sthale tu sā \|*  
*maraṇavyavasāyāttu nivṛttā sā harājñayā \|\| 273 \|\|*

*atha nāradavākyena codito himabhūdharaḥ \|*  
*kṛtābharaṇasaṃskārāṃ kṛtakautukamaṅgalām \|\| 274 \|\|*

273-274. Hearing those words of the Lord, Rati saluted Him and then went into the enchanting groves of the Himalaya. There, in that beautiful spot, for a long time, she wept bitterly over the destruction of Her Lord. She desisted from committing suicide only by the words of Shiva.

## \|\| 154.275-280 \|\|

*svargapuṣpakṛtāpīḍāṃ śubhracīnāṃśukāmbarām \|*  
*śarābhyāṃ saṃyutāṃ śailo gṛhītvā svasutāṃ tataḥ \|\| 275 \|\|*

*jagāma śubhayogena tadā sampūrṇamānasaḥ \|*  
*sakānanānyupākramya vanānyupavanāni ca \|\| 276 \|\|*

*dadarśa rudatīṃ nārīm apratarkyamahaujasam \|*  
*rūpeṇāsadṛśīṃ loke ramyeṣu vanasānuṣu \|\| 277 \|\|*

*kautukena parāmṛṣya tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rudatīṃ giriḥ \|*  
*upasarpya tatastasyā nikaṭe so 'bhyapṛcchata \|\| 278 \|\|*

*himavānuvāca*  
*kāsi kasyāsi kalyāṇi kimarthaṃ cāpi rodiṣi \|*  
*naitadalpamahaṃ manye kāraṇaṃ lokasundari \|\| 279 \|\|*

*sā tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca madhunā saha \|*  
*rudatī śokajananaṃ śvasatī dainyavardhanam \|\| 280 \|\|*

275-280. Afterwards, Himachala, prompted by the words of N toad a, gladly took his daughter at an auspicious hour to the hermitage of Shiva, after performing all the necessary ceremonies and dressing Her nicely, making Her put on handsome ornaments, decorating Her hair with flowers, and followed by a train of maids. Crossing through the dense forests, he found a weeping damsel in a beautiful grove on the Himalayas. Seeing such a lady of unsurpassing beauty and of extraordinary lustre, weeping so bitterly, He was astonished and being curious went to her, and said “Kalyanina! Who are you? Whose wife are you? Why are you weeping? It appears that your grief is great.”

## \|\| 154.281 \|\|

*ratiruvāca*  
*kāmasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ ratiṃ māṃ viddhi suvrata \|*  
*girāvasminmahābhāga giriśastapasi sthitaḥ \|\| 281 \|\|*

281\. On hearing such words of Himachala, the crying Rati explained to Him the cause of Her wailings.

## \|\| 154.282-286 \|\|

*tena pratyūharuṣṭena visphāryālokya locanam \|*  
*dagdho 'sau jhaṣaketustu mama kānto 'tivallabhaḥ \|\| 282 \|\|*

*ahaṃ tu śaraṇaṃ yātā taṃ devaṃ bhayavihvalā \|*  
*stutavatyatha saṃstutyā tato māṃ giriśo 'bravīt \|\| 283 \|\|*

*tuṣṭo 'haṃ kāmadayite kāmo 'yaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tvatstutiṃ cāpyadhīyāno naro bhaktyā madāśrayaḥ \|*  
*lapsyate kāṅkṣitaṃ kāmaṃ nivartya maraṇāditaḥ \|\| 284 \|\|*

*pratīkṣantī ca tadvākyam āśāveśādibhirhyaham \|*  
*śarīraṃ parirakṣiṣye kaṃcitkālaṃ mahādyute \|\| 285 \|\|*

*ityuktastu tadā ratyā śailaḥ saṃbhramabhīṣitaḥ \|*  
*pāṇāvādāya hi sutāṃ gantumaicchatsvakaṃ puram \|\| 286 \|\|*

282-286. She said: — “I am the wife of Cupid. Mahadeva is practising austerities in this mountain and He has reduced my Lord to ashes by opening His third wrathful eye. Afterwards, I sought His shelter through fear and began to pray when the Lord said that He was pleased with me and that my husband would be restored to life and one who would repeat the prayer uttered by me would get his objects accomplished and advised me to desist from death. Relying on His words I shall keep my body anyhow till then.”

## \|\| 154.287-288 \|\|

*bhāvino 'vaṣyabhāvitvād bhavitrī bhūtabhāvinī \|*  
*ladjamānā sakhimukhair uvāca pitaraṃ girim \|\| 287 \|\|*

*śailaduhitovāca*  
*durbhāgyeṇa śarīreṇa kiṃ mamānena kāraṇam \|*  
*kathaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ prāptaṃ sukhaṃ me sa patirbhavet \|\| 288 \|\|*

287-288. Hearing those words of Rati, Himachala began to shudder with fear. He thought of returning to his city and became ready to carry his daughter in his arms when Parvati said through Her maids.

## \|\| 154.289-292 \|\|

*tapobhiḥ prāpyate 'bhīṣṭaṃ nāsādhyaṃ hi tapasyataḥ \|*  
*durbhagatvaṃ vṛthā loko vahate sati sādhane \|\| 289 \|\|*

*jīvitāddurbhagācchreyo maraṇaṃ hyatapasyataḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyāmi na saṃdeho niyamaiḥ śoṣaye tanum \|\| 290 \|\|*

*tapasi bhraṣṭasaṃdeha udyamo 'rthajigīṣayā \|*  
*sāhaṃ tapaḥ kariṣyāmi yadahaṃ prāpya durlabhā \|\| 291 \|\|*

*ityuktaḥ śailarājastu duhitrā snehaviklavaḥ \|*  
*uvāca vācā śailendraḥ snehagadgadavarṇayā \|\| 292 \|\|*

289-292. Parvati said: — “What have I done to win a good husband. What is the use of having this unfortunate body? Desired objects are obtained by asceticism and there is nothing impossible for an ascetic. The world suffers pain in vain when there is such a way to fulfil one’s desires. Death is preferable to living the life of the unfortunate and not practising asceticism. I shall, certainly, consume my body by austerities. I have no doubt, that by this practice of Tapasya, I shall attain my desired object and so, I shall certainly practise penances.”

## \|\| 154.293-299 \|\|

*himavānuvāca*  
*umeti capale putri na kṣamaṃ tāvakaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*soḍhuṃ kleśasvarūpasya tapasaḥ saumyadarśane \|\| 293 \|\|*

*bhāvīnyabhivicāryāṇi padārthāni sadaiva tu \|*  
*bhāvino 'rthā bhavantyeva haṭhenānicchato 'pi vā \|\| 294 \|\|*

*tasmānna tapasā te 'sti bāle kiṃcitprayojanam \|*  
*bhavanāyaiva gacchāmaś cintayiṣyāmi tatra vai \|\| 295 \|\|*

*ityuktā tu yadā naiva guhāyābhyeti śailajā \|*  
*tataḥ sa cintayāviṣṭo duhitāṃ praśaśaṃsa ca \|\| 296 \|\|*

*tato 'ntarikṣe divyā vāg abhūdbhuvanabhūtale \|*  
*umeti capale putri tvayoktā tanayā tataḥ \|\| 297 \|\|*

*umeti nāma tenāsyā bhuvaneṣu bhaviṣyati \|*  
*siddhiṃ ca mūrtimatyeṣā sādhayiṣyati cintitām \|\| 298 \|\|*

*iti śrutvā tu vacanam ākāśātkāśapāṇḍuraḥ \|*  
*anujñāya sutāṃ śailo jagāmāśu svamandiram \|\| 299 \|\|*

293-299. Hearing such words of Parvati, Himachala stammered out with emotions “Daughter! Uma! Chapala! Your body is too delicate to bear the brunt of asceticism. Do not make such an attempt- Tapasya is very hard and painful indeed. What will be done will surely come to pass without fail. Even without any attempt, future things suddenly come to pass. So, O daughter! get up; let us go home. We will then think what ought to be done. Even at this, the daughter did not agree to return home. He was then plunged in anxieties and at that very instant, a voice from the welkin was heard “Himachala! Your daughter will be known in the world under the name of Uma and Chapala. Your daughter shall attain by her mere thinking, all the desires.”

## \|\| 154.300 \|\|

*sūta uvāca*  
*śailajāpi yayau śailam agamyamapi daivataiḥ \|*  
*sakhībhyāmanuyātā tu niyatā nagarājajā \|\| 300 \|\|*

300\. Hearing that, Himachala gave Her permission and returned to His abode, after taking leave of his daughter.

## \|\| 154.301-310 \|\|

*śṛṅgaṃ himavataḥ puṇyaṃ nānādhātuvibhūṣitam \|*  
*divyapuṣpalatākīrṇaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam \|\| 301 \|\|*

*nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ bhramarodghuṣṭapādapam \|*  
*divyaprasravaṇopetaṃ dīrghikābhiralaṃkṛtam \|\| 302 \|\|*

*nānāpakṣigaṇākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam \|*  
*jalajasthalajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ protphullairupaśobhitam \|\| 303 \|\|*

*citrakandarasaṃsthānaṃ guhāgṛhamanoharam \|*  
*vihaṅgasaṃghasaṃjuṣṭaṃ kalpapādapasaṃkaṭam \|\| 304 \|\|*

*tatrāpaṣyanmahāśākhaṃ śākhinaṃ haritacchadam \|*  
*sarvartukusumopetaṃ manorathaśatodjvalam \|\| 305 \|\|*

*nānāpuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvidhaphalānvitam \|*  
*nataṃ sūryasya rucibhir bhinnasaṃhṛtapallavam \|\| 306 \|\|*

*tatrāmbarāṇi saṃtyajya bhūṣaṇāni ca śailajā \|*  
*saṃvītā valkalairdivyair darbhanirmitamekhalā \|\| 307 \|\|*

*triḥsnātā pāṭalāhārā babhūva śaradāṃ śatam \|*  
*śatamekena śīrṇena parṇenāvartayattadā \|\| 308 \|\|*

*nirāhārā śataṃ sābhūt samānāṃ tapasāṃ nidhiḥ \|*  
*tata udvejitāḥ sarve prāṇinastattapo 'gninā \|\| 309 \|\|*

*tataḥ sasmāra bhagavān munīnsapta śatakratuḥ \|*  
*te samāgamya munayaḥ sarve samuditāstataḥ \|\| 310 \|\|*

301-310. Suta said: — Parvati went to practise austerities to a beautiful part of the mountain impassable even to the Devas. Parvati accompanied by Her maids went to that peak of the Himalaya that was very beautiful and resplendent with various ores, blossoming creepers, Siddhas, Gandharvas herds of deer, and various birds, buzzsing of the black bees, cascades, trees, smelling with the aroma of flowers, having beautiful caves, groups of chirping birds, adorned with kalpa trees, gay with the flowers of all the seasons, loaded with various kinds of fruits, illumined by the rays of the Sun and full of different kinds of animals. She saw a big tree with many large branches, having yellow leaves, flowering in all the seasons, adorned with all sorts of flowers, and various fruits and bright as Manoratha. The Sun’s rays fell on the tree and it seemed, that the Sun was also overpowered by the brilliancy of the tree. There, Parvati discarding Her ornaments and dress, donned the bark of tree, and began to bathe thrice daily. She passed a century living on the leaves of trees, another century on the fallen leaves of trees; and observed a fast for another century. She thus continued Her penances observing similar ordinances.

## \|\| 154.311-313 \|\|

*pūjitāśca mahendreṇa papracchustaṃ prayojanam \|*  
*kimarthaṃ tu suraśreṣṭha saṃsmṛtāstu vayaṃ tvayā \|\| 311 \|\|*

*śakraḥ provāca śṛṇvantu bhagavantaḥ prayojanam \|*  
*himācale tapo ghoraṃ tapyate bhūdharātmajā \|*  
*tasyā hyabhimataṃ kāmaṃ bhavantaḥ kartumarhatha \|\| 312 \|\|*

*tataḥ samāpatandevyā jagadarthaṃ tvarānvitāḥ \|*  
*tathetyuktvā tu śailendraṃ siddhasaṃghātasevitam \|\| 313 \|\|*

311-313. Then the creation began to tremble by the power of Her asceticism when Indra thought of the seven Rishis. They appeared before Indra with great pleasure and were adored by him when They ashed him the reason of his having thought of them. Indra said “ Rishis! hear my object. Parvati is practising severe austerities on the peak of the Himalaya, and I want you to fulfil Her object.

## \|\| 154.314-319 \|\|

*ūcurāgatya munayas tāmatho madhurākṣaram \|*  
*putri kiṃ te vyavasitaḥ kāmaḥ kamalalocane \|\| 314 \|\|*

*tānuvāca tato devī saladjā gauravānmunīn \|*  
*tapasyato mahābhāgāḥ prāpya maune bhavādṛśān \|\| 315 \|\|*

*vandanāya niuktā dhīḥ pāvayatyavikalpitam \|*  
*praśnonmukhatvādbhavatāṃ uktamāsanamāditaḥ \|\| 316 \|\|*

*upaviṣṭāḥ śramonmuktās tataḥ prakṣyatha māmataḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā sā tataścakre kṛtāsanaparigrahān \|\| 317 \|\|*

*sā tu tānvidhivatpūjyān pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*uvācādityasaṃkāśān munīnsapta satī śanaiḥ \|\| 318 \|\|*

*tyaktvā vratātmakaṃ maunaṃ maunaṃ jagrāha hrīmayam \|*  
*bhāvaṃ tasyāstu maunāntaṃ tasyāḥ saptarṣayo yathā \|\| 319 \|\|*

314-319. Hearing which They repaired to the spot where Parvati was practising asceticism and said to Her: — “Daughter! what is your wish?” Then Parvati bashfully said “It is wise to observe silence before the great sages like you. Those who salute sages like you are purified by you and you question me right in the face.” She, then, offered them a seat and said — “After you have rested and when the toil of your journey has disappeared, you better question me.”

## \|\| 154.320-328 \|\|

*gauravādhīnatāṃ prāptāḥ papracchustāṃ punastathā \|*  
*sāpi gauravagarbheṇa manasā cāruhāsinī \|\| 320 \|\|*

*munīñśāntakathālāpān prekṣya provāca vāgyamam \|*  
*bhagavanto vijānanti prāṇināṃ mānasaṃ hitam \|\| 321 \|\|*

*manogatībhiratyarthaṃ kadarthante hi dehinaḥ \|*  
*kecit tu nipuṇāstatra ghaṭante vibudhodyamaiḥ \|\| 322 \|\|*

*upāyairdurlabhānbhāvān prāpnuvanti hyatandritāḥ \|*  
*apare tu paricchinnā nānākārābhyupakramāḥ \|\| 323 \|\|*

*dehāntarārthamārambham āśrayanti hitapradam \|*  
*mama tvākāśasambhūta-puṣpadāmā vibhūṣitam \|\| 324 \|\|*

*vandhyā sutaṃ prāptukāmā manaḥ prasarate muhuḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ kila bhavaṃ devaṃ patiṃ prāptuṃ samudyatā \|\| 325 \|\|*

*prakṛtyaiva durādharṣaṃ tapasyantaṃ tu saṃprati \|*  
*surāsurairanirṇītaṃ paramārthakriyāśrayam \|\| 326 \|\|*

*sāṃprataṃ cāpi nirdagdha-madanaṃ vītarāgiṇam \|*  
*kathamārādhayedīśaṃ mādṛśī tādṛśaṃ śivam \|\| 327 \|\|*

*ityuktā munayaste tu sthiratāṃ manasastataḥ \|*  
*jñātumasyā vacaḥ procuḥ prakramātprakṛtārthakam \|\| 328 \|\|*

320-328. Then she worshipped them according to the prescribed rituals and though Uma shining like the Sun, cast off Her vow of silence for a while, she again held her peace of mind: when the sages began to question Her with regard to Her object, She putting on a smile, bashfully said in a gentle voice. “You know the hearts of all beings. It is pleasing to hear words when they express what one wants most dear and sweet to heart. The beings are always eager to attain what they hold dear and love it most. Some clever persons resort to divine means; others resort to various pleasant deities and ceremonies as ordained in the Shastras. But my mind always rushes to attain my dear wish, like a barren woman desiring a son; or, one longing Heavenly flowers. I am now making earnest attempt to have Lord Shiva as my husband who is naturally very difficult to be attained and who is moreover at present engaged in His tapasya. This is a very difficult thing indeed, for how can Shiva devoid of delusion and passion, devoted to asceticism, Whose actions cannot be discerned even by the Devas and the demons and Who has consumed Cupid not very long ago, be attained by a girl like me?”

## \|\| 154.329-341 \|\|

*munaya ūcuḥ*  
*dvividhaṃ tu sukhaṃ tāvat putri lokeṣu bhāvyate \|*  
*śarīrasyāsya saṃbhogaiś cetasaścāpi nirvṛtiḥ \|\| 329 \|\|*

*prakṛtyā sa tu digvāsā bhīmaḥ pitṛvaṇeśayaḥ \|*  
*kapālī bhikṣuko nagno virūpākṣaḥ sthirakriyaḥ \|\| 330 \|\|*

*pramattonmattakākāro bībhatsakṛtasaṃgrahaḥ \|*  
*yatinā tena kaste 'rtho mūrtānarthena kāṅkṣitaḥ \|\| 331 \|\|*

*yadi hyasya śarīrasya bhogamicchasi sāṃpratam \|*  
*tatkathaṃ te mahādevād bhayabhājo jugupsitāt \|\| 332 \|\|*

*sravadraktavasābhyakta-kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇāt \|*  
*śvasadugrabhujaṃgendra-kṛtabhūṣaṇabhīṣaṇāt \|\| 333 \|\|*

*śmaśānavāsino raudra-pramathānugatāt sati \|*  
*surendramukuṭavrāta-nighṛṣṭacaraṇo 'rihā \|\| 334 \|\|*

*harirasti jagaddhātā śrīkānto 'nantamūrtimān \|*  
*nātho yajñabhujāmasti tathendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ \|\| 335 \|\|*

*devatānāṃ nidhiścāsti jvalanaḥ sarvakāmakṛt \|*  
*vāurasti jagaddhātā yaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvadehinām \|\| 336 \|\|*

*tathā vaiśravaṇo rājā sarvārthamatimānvibhuḥ \|*  
*ebhya ekatamaṃ kasmān na tvaṃ samprāptumicchasi \|\| 337 \|\|*

*utānyadehasaṃprāptyā sukhaṃ te manasepsitam \|*  
*evametattavāpyatra prabhavo nākasaṃpadām \|*  
*asminneva parāḥ sarvāḥ kalyāṇaprāptayastava \|\| 338 \|\|*

*piturevāsti tatsarvaṃ surebhyo yanna vidyate \|*  
*atastatprāptaye kleśaḥ sa vāpyatrāphalastava \|\| 339 \|\|*

*prāyeṇa prārthito bhadre susvalpo hyatidurlabhaḥ \|*  
*asya te vidhiyogasya dhātā kartātra caiva hi \|\| 340 \|\|*

*sūta uvāca*  
*ityuktā sā tu kupitā munivaryeṣu śailajā \|*  
*uvāca koparaktākṣī sphuradbhirdaśanacchadaiḥ \|\| 341 \|\|*

329-341. Hearing those words the sages controlling Their mind and realizing Her object said “Daughter! There are two kinds of comforts in the world and the first one is the gratification of the body; the second is the peace of the mind. Lord Shiva is, by nature naked, ferocious, Dweller of foe cremation ground, the carrier of skulls, a hermit, statue-like in action, a beggar, mad, fond of collecting ugly and terrible things, and inauspiciousness incarnate. What advantage will you get in having Him as your husband? If you, perchance, wish the gratification of carnal desires how can it be gained? He is the source of fear and an object of aversion and censure. He is the wearer of a necklace of gory heads, adorning Himself with terribly hissing snakes, living in the cremation ground, moving about with His ferocious attendants. How then can you expect to derive comfort from Him? Why do you not marry one of These, viz. — Vishnu, the protector of the -Universe, the destroyer of enemies, adorned by the Devas and the Lord of Lakshmi and sacrifice, Indra, the Lord of the Devas, Agni the giver of everything, Vayu the soul of every being, and Kuvera, the Lord of riches. And if you desire the happiness m the next world in another body, even then the Devas are capable to give you that. There is no chance of getting any happiness in this world or m the next from Shiva. Again what the Devas do not possess, your father has got that'- so by the grace of your father, you can get happiness without any trouble. So it is useless for you to undergo so much trouble. You will have to undergo sufferings for the attainment of Shiva and no good will result. Even a trifle sought with great eagerness becomes unattainable. Only Brahma can fulfil your desire.”

## \|\| 154.342 \|\|

*devyuvāca*  
*asadgrahasya kā prītir vyasanasya kva yantraṇā \|*  
*viparītārthaboddhāraḥ satpathe kena yojitāḥ \|\| 342 \|\|*

342\. Suta said: — Hearing such words of the Rishis, Parvati got very angry with them and with red eyes and trembling lips said.

## \|\| 154.353-355 \|\|

*kasya prādurabhūddhyānāt prakṣubdhāḥ prākṛtāṃśakāḥ \|*  
*prakṛtau tu tṛtīyāyāṃ madhudviḍjananakriyā \|\| 353 \|\|*

*jātā sasarja ṣaḍvargān buddhipūrvān svakarmajān \|*  
*ajātako 'bhavadvedhā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|\| 354 \|\|*

*yaḥ svayogena saṃkṣobhya prakṛtiṃ kṛtavānidam \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ siddhasarvārtham aiśvaryaṃ lokakartṛtām \|\| 355 \|\|*

353-355. Devi said How can Those who hanker after unreal objects and are subject to vices, be devoted to a high Deva? What pleasure is there in setting an unreal object? and what pain is there when one is devotedly attached to an object? You are on the right path and yet how do you come to such a contrary conclusion. You should know that I am a fool and I want to get an undesired object. You all are like Prajapati and see all things; but it is quite certain that you do not know that eternal Ishana the Lord of the world, unborn, unmanifested, of immeasurable glory. The Devas Vishnu, Brahma, etc., do not know Him; then what use is there in judging of His essence. But are you not aware even of His glory that is manifest in all the beings, and all the Universes? Whose are these forms Sky, fire, air, earth and water. Whom do they manifest? Who has got the Sun and the Moon for His Eyes? Whose phallus do the Devas and the demons worship devout-fully? Do you not know His glory who is called Maha Deva by Brahma and Indra, etc.? Whose mother is Aditi and who has given birth to Vishnu? Narayana and other Devas have been born of Aditi from Kashyapa. Kashyapa has been born of Marichi. Aditi is the daughter of Daksha. Marichi and Daksha, both of them, were born of Brahma and by praying Whom did Brahma get His birth from the golden egg? By whose meditation, the part of Prakriti was agitated and was turned into the golden egg? From whose third Prakriti, the slayer of Madhu was born? Whose Buddhi has created these six vargas out of their own Karmas?

**Комментарий:**

Note. — … Third Prakriti, i.e., Tamasa. … =The six classes of objects of worldly existence.

## \|\| 154.356-366 \|\|

*vidurviṣṇvādayo yacca svamahimnā sadaiva hi \|*  
*kṛtvānyaṃ deham anyā dṛk tādṛk kṛtvā punarhariḥ \|\| 356 \|\|*

*kurute jagataḥ kṛtyam uttamādhamamadhyamam \|*  
*evameva hi saṃsāro yo janmamaraṇātmakaḥ \|\| 357 \|\|*

*karmaṇaśca phalaṃ hyetan nānārūpasamudbhavam \|*  
*atha nārāyaṇo devaḥ svakāṃ chāyāṃ samāśrayat \|\| 358 \|\|*

*tatpreritaḥ prakurute janma nānāprakārakam \|*  
*sāpi karmaṇa evoktā preraṇā vivaśātmanām \|\| 359 \|\|*

*yathonmādādijuṣṭasya matireva hi sā bhavet \|*  
*iṣṭānyeva yathārthāni viparītāni manyate \|\| 360 \|\|*

*lokasya vyavahāreṣu sṛṣṭeṣu sahate sadā \|*  
*dharmādharmaphalāvāptau viṣṇureva nibodhitaḥ \|\| 361 \|\|*

*athānāditvamasyāsti sāmānyāttu tadātmanā \|*  
*na hyasya jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dehe tu kutracit \|\| 362 \|\|*

*bhavadbhiryasya no dṛṣṭam antaragramathāpi vā \|*  
*dehināṃ dharma evaiṣa kvacidjāyetkacinmriyet \|\| 363 \|\|*

*kvacidgarbhagato naśyet kvacij jīvedjarāmayaḥ \|*  
*kvacitsamāḥ śataṃ jīvet kvacidbālye vipadyate \|\| 364 \|\|*

*śatāuḥ puruṣo yastu so 'nantaḥ svalpajanmanaḥ \|*  
*jīvito na mriyatyagre tasmātso 'mara ucyate \|\| 365 \|\|*

*adṛṣṭajanmanidhanā hy evaṃ viṣṇvādayo matāḥ \|*  
*etatsaṃśuddhamaiśvaryaṃ saṃsāre ko labhediha \|\| 366 \|\|*

356-366. “Brahma, of unmanifested birth is not born; by His power He disequilibriates the Gunas and creates this material universe. Brahma is the Lord of the universe and has extraordinary powers. Vishnu and other Devas assume different shapes by their extraordinary powers. Vishnu also enters others bodies through His Maya and does the uttama (excellent), madhyama (middling), and adhama (inferior) karmas of the world. The world is liable to perish and to be re-born.

The fruits of Karma are also various. Many classes of men are born in it by virtue of their deeds. Narayana relying on and propelled by His shadow takes various kinds of births and that shadow impels people unconsciously to actions. Being thus impelled people, like lunatics, consider what is good to be bad and what is bad to be good. So Vishnu is the sole cause of the so-called Dharma and Ad harm a seen in these created customs and usages. Though this Karma, Dharma and Adharma is beginningless, yet in ordinary bodies, it is- not seen of long duration. You also have not seen the beginning nor the end of Vishnu. Corporal bodies perish somewhere and are re-born at another place. Sometimes they die in the womb, sometimes, they live up to old age, sometimes, they go on up to a hundred years, and sometimes they are nipped in the bud in their early ages.

## \|\| 154.367-372 \|\|

*tatra kṣayādiyogāttu nānāścaryasvarūpiṇi \|*  
*tasmāddivaścarānsarvān malinānsvalpabhūtikān \|\| 367 \|\|*

*nāhaṃ bhadrāḥ kilecchāmi ṛte śarvātpinākinaḥ \|*  
*sthitaṃ ca tāratamyena prāṇināṃ paramaṃ tvidam \|\| 368 \|\|*

*dhībalaiśvaryakāryādi-pramāṇaṃ mahatāṃ mahat \|*  
*yasmānna kiṃcidaparaṃ sarvaṃ yasmātpravartate \|\| 369 \|\|*

*yasyaiśvaryamanādyantaṃ tamahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā \|*  
*eṣa me vyavasāyaśca dīrgho 'tiviparītakaḥ \|\| 370 \|\|*

*yāta vā tiṣṭhataivātha munayo madvidhāyakāḥ \|*  
*evaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ devyā munivarāstadā \|\| 371 \|\|*

*ānandāśruparītākṣāḥ sasvajustāṃ tapasvinīm \|*  
*ūcuśca paramaprītāḥ śailajāṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 372 \|\|*

367-372. “One, who lives a hundred years, is said to enjoy a full life and is said to live for an infinite period with regard to a short — lived man. One, who is born first and does not die early, is said to be Amara (immortal). In this way, the Devas like Vishnu etc., are said to be immortal. Who can attain such pure bliss and powers in this universe so full of various wonderful things? I do not, therefore, feel inclined to marry the Devas predominant with trifling transient glories like Satva, etc. I shall only marry Shiva who is the most supreme among the Devas and all the beings. This idea of difference is the special characteristic of the worldly people. I take refuge unto Him, the Lord Shiva whose intelligence, strength, extraordinary power and excellences are greater than those of the great beyond whom nothing exists, from whom all this Universe has originated and whose good qualities have neither beginning nor any end. This is my determination; it is very strong and seems to be contrary, and the sages offering me advice may go or stay.”

## \|\| 154.373 \|\|

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*atyadbhutāsyaho putri jñānamūrtirivāmalā \|*  
*prasādayati no bhāvaṃ bhavabhāvapratiśrayāt \|\| 373 \|\|*

373\. Hearing such words of Parvati the sages were overcome with emotions and spoke to the ascetic Parvati in very sweet words:

## \|\| 154.374-379 \|\|

*nanu vidmo vayaṃ tasya devasyaiśvaryamadbhutam \|*  
*tvanniścayasya dṛḍhatāṃ vettuṃ vayamihāgatāḥ \|\| 374 \|\|*

*acirādeva tanvaṅgi kāmaste 'yaṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*kvādityasya prabhā yāti ratnebhyaḥ kva dyutiḥ pṛthak \|\| 375 \|\|*

*ko 'rtho varṇālikāvyaktaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ giriśaṃ vinā \|*  
*yāmo naikābhyupāyane tamabhyarthayituṃ vayam \|\| 376 \|\|*

*asmākamapi vai so 'rthaḥ sutarāṃ hṛdi vartate \|*  
*atastvameva sā buddhir yato nītistvameva hi \|\| 377 \|\|*

*ato niḥsaṃśayaṃ kāyaṃ śaṃkaro 'pi vidhāsyati \|*  
*ityuktvā pūjitā yātā munayo girikanyayā \|\| 378 \|\|*

*prayayurgiriśaṃ draṣṭuṃ prasthaṃ himavato mahat \|*  
*gaṅgāmbuplāvitātmānaṃ piṅgabaddhajaṭāsaṭam \|\| 379 \|\|*

374-379. The Rishis said: — “O daughter! It is highly astonishing. You are the incarnation of pure undefiled wisdom; be pleased with us. We are very pleased to see your firm, unshakable faith in Mahadeva; at this, our inner natures are highly purified. Indeed, we could not realize the extraordinary glory of that Mahadeva. We have come here to see only how firm are you in your Tapasya. Your object will very soon be accomplished. As the radiance of the Sun and the jewels is inseparable from, them and as the purport of writing is inseparable from the letters, similarly you are not apart from Shiva. This belief is firmly implanted in our hearts. When you, who are full of intelligence and morals, have made such an attempt to get Shiva, then He will certainly see to it. Shiva will undoubtedly accomplish your object.”

## \|\| 154.380-386 \|\|

*bhṛṅgānuyātapāṇistha-mandārakusumasrajam \|*  
*gireḥ samprāpya te prasthaṃ dadṛśuḥ śaṃkarāśramam \|\| 380 \|\|*

*praśāntāśeṣasattvaughaṃ navastimitakānanam \|*  
*niḥśabdākṣobhasalila-prapātaṃ sarvatodiśam \|\| 381 \|\|*

*tatrāpaṣyaṃstato dvāri vīrakaṃ vetrapāṇinam \|*  
*sapta te munayaḥ pūjyā vinītāḥ kāryagauravāt \|\| 382 \|\|*

*ūcurmadhurabhāṣiṇyā vācā te vāgmināṃ varāḥ \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ vayamihāyātāḥ śaraṇyaṃ gaṇanāyakam \|\| 383 \|\|*

*trilocanaṃ vijānīhi surakāryapracoditāḥ \|*  
*tvameva no gatistattvaṃ yathā kālānatikramaḥ \|\| 384 \|\|*

*sā prārthanaiṣā prāyeṇa pratīhāramayaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*ityukto munibhiḥ so 'tha gauravāttānuvāca saḥ \|\| 385 \|\|*

*savanasyāparāṃ saṃdhyāṃ snātuṃ mandākinījale \|*  
*kṣaṇena bhavitā viprās tatra drakṣyatha śūlinam \|\| 386 \|\|*

380-386. Parvati again adored those sages on Their having said so. The Saptarishis, then, went to Shiva. They arrived at a beautiful tableland on the top of the Himalayas. There, they saw that the tableland had put on the yellow matted hairs and were shedding showers of the knowledge of Self; and the mountain was holding the garland of Mandara in its hands composed of the swarms of bees. There, They saw diva’s hermitage and the Lord with His conscience purified by the sacred waters of the Ganges, with His yellow plaits of hair, wearing the garland of Kalpa flowers and surrounded by a swarm of black bees.

There they found all the animals in a peaceful disposition. The cascades o£ water were also not agitated. The attendant Viraka was standing at the door with a cane in his hand and adored the seven sages when the latter said that They had come there to meet the Lord Shiva on some great business of the Devas. They said that they wanted to see Shiva for the fulfilment of the purposes of the Devas. He was to be their intermediary, so that they might not be put to unnecessary delay. He was to kindly inform Him of their arrival.

## \|\| 154.387 \|\|

*ityuktā munayastasthus te tatkālapratīkṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*gambhīrāmbudharaṃ prāvṛṭ-tṛṣitāścātakā yathā \|\| 387 \|\|*

387\. Viraka gave them seats and replied: — “O Brahmanas! You can meet the Lord after He has finished His bath in the waters of the Mandakini and finished His Sandhya, Vandanani; wait for a while”

## \|\| 154.388 \|\|

*tataḥ kṣaṇena niṣpanna-samādhānakriyāvidhiḥ \|*  
*vīrāsanaṃ bibhedeśo mṛgacarmanivāsitam \|\| 388 \|\|*

388\. The Rishis waited and remained fixed on the spot like Chataka bird during the rainy season to get drops of rainwater.

## \|\| 154.389-394 \|\|

*tato vinīto jānubhyām avalambya mahīsthitim \|*  
*uvāca vīrako devaṃ praṇāmaikasamāśrayaḥ \|\| 389 \|\|*

*samprāptā munayaḥ sapta tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ dīptatejasaḥ \|*  
*vibho samādiśa draṣṭum avagantum ihārhasi \|*  
*te 'bruvandevakāryeṇa tava darśanalālasāḥ \|\| 390 \|\|*

*ityukto dhūrjaṭistena vīrakeṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*bhūbhaṅgasaṃjñayā teṣāṃ praveśājñāṃ dadau tadā \|\| 391 \|\|*

*mūrdhnaḥ kampena tānsarvān vīrako 'pi mahāmunīn \|*  
*ājuhāvāvidūrasthān darśanāya pinākinaḥ \|\| 392 \|\|*

*tvarābaddhārdhacūḍāste lambamānājināmbarāḥ \|*  
*viviśurvedikāṃ siddhāṃ giriśasya vibhūtibhiḥ \|\| 393 \|\|*

*baddhapāṇipuṭākṣipta-nākapuṣpotkarāstataḥ \|*  
*pinākipādaugalaṃ vandyaṃ nākanivāsinām \|\| 394 \|\|*

389-394. After a short while, Lord Shiva after finishing His bath, took His seat on a deer skin when the attendant Virabhadra bowed down and meekly said: — “Lord! The seven illustrious sages have come to see you on the errand of the Devas and They are eager to be ushered in your august presence.” At that, the Lord made a sign to Virabhadra to let Them come. Then Virabhadra beckoned to the sages standing at a distance to come in.

## \|\| 154.395-396 \|\|

*tataḥ snigdhekṣitāḥ śāntā munayaḥ śūlapāṇinā \|*  
*manmathāriṃ tato hṛṣṭāḥ samaṃ tuṣṭuvurādṛtāḥ \|\| 395 \|\|*

*munaya ūcuḥ*  
*aho kṛtārthā vayameva sāṃprataṃ sureśvaro 'pyatra varo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*bhavatprasādāmalavārisekataḥ phalena kācit tapasā niujyate \|\| 396 \|\|*

395-396. The sages, with their matted hair tied up into a knot and with long deerskins hanging on them, appeared before the Lord, with folded hands, and approaching Him, removed the celestial flowers presented to His feet by the Devas, and bowed down and touched His feet. Lord Shiva cast an affectionate glance towards them when they gladly chanted His praises

## \|\| 154.397-403 \|\|

*jayatyasau dhanyataro himācalas tadāśrayaṃ yasya sutā tapasyati \|*  
*sa daityarājo 'pi mahāphalodayo vimūlitāśeṣasuro hi tārakaḥ \|\| 397 \|\|*

*tvadīyamaṃśaṃ pravilokya kalmaṣāt svakaṃ śarīraṃ parimokṣyate hi yaḥ \|*  
*sa dhanyadhīrlokapitā caturmukho hariśca yatsaṃbhramavahnidīpitaḥ \|\| 398 \|\|*

*tvadaṅghriugmaṃ hṛdayena bibhrato mahābhitāpapraśamaikahetukam \|*  
*tvameva caiko vividhākṛtakriyaḥ kileti vācā vidhurair vibhāṣyate \|\| 399 \|\|*

*athādya ekastvamavādi nānyathā jagattathā nirghṛṇatāṃ tava spṛśet \|*  
*na vetsi vā duḥkhamidaṃ prajātmakaṃ vihanyate te khalu sarvataḥ kriyā \|\| 400 \|\|*

*upekṣase cej jagatāmupadravaṃ dayāmayatvaṃ tava kena kathyate \|*  
*svayogamāyāmahimāguhāśrayaṃ na vidyate nirmalabhūtigauravam \|\| 401 \|\|*

*vayaṃ ca te dhanyatarāḥ śarīriṇāṃ yadīdṛśaṃ tvāṃ pravilokayāmahe \|*  
*adarśanaṃ tena manoratho yathā prayāti sāphalyatayā manogatam \|\| 402 \|\|*

*jagadvidhānaikavidhau jaganmukhe kariṣyase 'to balabhiccarā vayam \|*  
*vinemuritthaṃ munayo visṛjya tāṃ giraṃ girīśaśrutibhūmisaṃnidhau \|\| 403 \|\|*

397-403. The Munis said: —“O Lord Siva! we are highly gratified, so is Indra. The Lord of the Devas is sitting before us. What better fruit can, one, practising a hard Tapasya, expect than one’s getting Thy favour? This Himachala is blessed whose daughter is practising devout asceticism to get Thee. Tarakasura, the annihilator of the Devas, is also blessed for he will leave his body through Thy son. Brahma and Vishnu, who are now being highly tormented by the power and influence of Tarakasura, are also blessed on account of Their contemplating on Thee the Destroyer of ills. Thou art described to be the Doer of many things under many forms. The stupid persons chant Thy name only under various words. Thou art the only one who knowest all about the Universe; else Thou wouldst be known as pitiless. Or, it can be said Thou knowest nothing of this painful world. For Thou art action less. And if Thou dost remain indifferent, seeing all these pains and troubles, then, how can we call Thee merciful. Thou dost rest on Thy Yoga Maya; hence, Thou art pure and undefiled and Thou dost take no pride in good deeds, powers and vibhutis. We are blessed among the corporal beings, otherwise, how could we have met Thee? Now this is our prayer: — That our desires may be fulfilled by meeting Thee. Now it behovest Thee to act, in such a way see this universe which is now in trouble may come to peace. We are Se messengers of the Deva Indra. We, consequently, how down to Thee.”

## \|\| 154.404 \|\|

*utkṛṣṭakedāra ivāvanītale subījamuṣṭiṃ suphalāya karṣakāḥ \|\| 404 \|\|*

404\. The seven sages expressed Their prayers sweetly as a good farmer scatters his seeds in a well-ploughed field and then bowed down to Him,

## \|\| 154.405 \|\|

*teṣāṃ śrutvā tu tāṃ ramyāṃ prakramopakramakriyām \|*  
*vācaṃ vācaspatistuṣṭaḥ provāca smitasundarīm \|\| 405 \|\|*

405 Hearing the prayers of the Rishis, the Lord smilingly said like Brihaspati.

## \|\| 154.406-408 \|\|

*śarva uvāca*  
*jāne lokavidhānasya kanyā satkāryamuttamam \|*  
*jātā prāleyaśailasya saṃketakanirūpaṇāḥ \|\| 406 \|\|*

*satyamutkaṇṭhitāḥ sarve devakāryārthamudyatāḥ \|*  
*teṣāṃ tvaranti cetāṃsi kiṃtu kāryaṃ vivakṣitam \|\| 407 \|\|*

*lokayātrānugantavyā viśeṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*sevante te yato dharmaṃ tatprāmāṇyātpare sthitāḥ \|\| 408 \|\|*

406-408. Shankara said. — “I know the excellent work that has cropped up for the preservation of the world, and that a daughter has been born in the house of Himachala. You are also doing your best to promote the cause of the Devas. True! Everyone is anxious to fulfil God’s purposes but though one desires quickness, yet there is some delay here. It is necessary, that the wise should follow the rules and customs; for the ordinary people will follow that.”

## \|\| 154.409 \|\|

*ityuktā munayo jagmus tvaritāstu himācalam \|*  
*tatra te pūjitāstena himaśailena sādaram \|*  
*ūcurmunivarāḥ prītāḥ svalpavarṇaṃ tvarānvitāḥ \|\| 409 \|\|*

409\. Hearing those words of Shiva the seven sages saluted Him and went to Himachala where they were adored by Him with great hospitality and endearment after which the sages uttered a few words hurriedly.

## \|\| 154.410-411 \|\|

*munaya ūcuḥ*  
*devo duhitaraṃ sākṣāt pinākī tava mārgate \|*  
*tacchīghraṃ pāvayātmānam āhutyevānalārpaṇāt \|\| 410 \|\|*

*kāryametacca devānāṃ suciraṃ parivartate \|*  
*jagaduddharaṇāyaiṣa kriyatāṃ vai samudyamaḥ \|\| 411 \|\|*

410-411. The sages said: — “O Himachala! Mahadeva, the Lord Himself, asks for Your daughter. You should, therefore, make over your daughter to Him in the presence of Fire. The great work of the Devas is pending long since, and you should fulfil it for the salvation of the Universe.”

## \|\| 154.412-413 \|\|

*ityuktastaistadā śailo harṣāviṣṭo 'vadanmunīn \|*  
*asamartho 'bhavadvaktum uttaraṃ prārthayañchivam \|\| 412 \|\|*

*tato menā munīnvīkṣya provāca snehaviklavā \|*  
*duhitustānmunīṃścaiva caraṇāśrayam arthavit \|\| 413 \|\|*

412-413. Hearing those words, Himachala tried to speak, but could not give a reply distinctly, being overcome with emotions. He mentally approved of it. The clever Mena, then saluting the Munis, began to speak out Her mind, deeply affected by her love towards her daughter.

## \|\| 154.414-417 \|\|

*menovāca*  
*yadarthaṃ duhiturjanma necchantyapi mahāphalam \|*  
*tadevopasthitaṃ sarvaṃ prakrameṇaiva sāṃpratam \|\| 414 \|\|*

*kulajanmavayorūpa-vibhūtyṛddhiuto 'pi yaḥ \|*  
*varastasyāpi cāhūya sutā deyā hyayācataḥ \|\| 415 \|\|*

*tatsamastatapoghoraṃ kathaṃ putrī prayāsyati \|*  
*putrīvākyādyadatrāsti vidheyaṃ tadvidhīyatām \|\| 416 \|\|*

*ityuktā munayaste tu priyayā himabhūbhṛtaḥ \|*  
*ūcuḥ punarudārārthaṃ nārīcittaprasādakam \|\| 417 \|\|*

414-417. Mena said: — Though the birth of a daughter is highly meritorious, yet, what people do not like, has just taken place with regard to my daughter. One ought to marry one’s daughter to a man who is well-qualified as regards his family, birth, age, beauty, good qualifications and wealth and who does not himself seek for a bride. How, then, can I give my daughter to one whose only qualification is his asceticism. Now do according to the wishes of my daughter. The Munis then replied in words suited to please women.

## \|\| 154.418-421 \|\|

*munaya ūcuḥ*  
*aiśvaryamavagacchasva śaṃkarasya surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*ārādhyamānapādābja-yugalatvātsunirvṛtaiḥ \|\| 418 \|\|*

*yasyopayogi yadrūpaṃ sā ca tatprāptaye ciram \|*  
*ghoraṃ tapasyate bālā tena rūpeṇa nirvṛtiḥ \|\| 419 \|\|*

*yastadvratāni divyāni nayiṣyati samāpanam \|*  
*tatra sāvahitā tāvat tasmāt saiva bhaviṣyati \|\| 420 \|\|*

*ityuktvā giriṇā sārdhaṃ te yayuryatra śailajā \|*  
*jitārkajvalanajvālā tapastejomayī hyumā \|\| 421 \|\|*

418-421. The Munis said: — Hear now about the qualifications of Shankara. The Devas and the Asuras worship, with great devotion, His feet. Whoever wants anything, gets that from Him. Therefore, this girl has practised severe austerities long since to attain Him. She, the Devi, will be greatly pleased on anybody who will enable Her to attain the fruits of Her vow. Having said so, the Saptarishis took Himachala with them and repaired to Parvati.

## \|\| 154.422-424 \|\|

*procustāṃ munayaḥ snigdhaṃ saṃmānya pathamāgatam \|*  
*ramyaṃ priyaṃ manohāri mā rūpaṃ tapasā daha \|\| 422 \|\|*

*prātaste śaṃkaraḥ pāṇim eṣa putri grahīṣyati \|*  
*vayamarthitavantaste pitaraṃ pūrvamāgatāḥ \|\| 423 \|\|*

*pitrā saha gṛhaṃ gaccha vayaṃ yāmaḥ svamandiram \|\| 424 \|\|*

422-424. The sages sweetly addressed the auspicious Parvati who was radiant like the Sun with Her fire of asceticism. \_ They said, “O, Beautiful one! do not consume yourself any, more with such a rigid asceticism. Early in the next morning Lord Shiva will accept your lotus hands.

"We had first gone to pray to Thy father and Thou shouldst now return home with him”.

## \|\| 154.425-426 \|\|

*ityuktā tapasaḥ satyaṃ phalamastīti cintya sā \|*  
*tvaramāṇā yayau veśma piturdivyārthaśobhitam \|\| 425 \|\|*

*sā tatra rajanīṃ mene varṣāutasamāṃ satī \|*  
*haradarśanasaṃjāta-mahotkaṇṭhā himādrijā \|\| 426 \|\|*

425-426. Hearing those words Parvati exclaimed “Oh! Tapasya yields fruit,” and instantly went to Her father’s home considering Her asceticism as accomplished. There she felt a single night like a long period of 10,000 years and became greatly eager to meet Shiva.

## \|\| 154.427-428 \|\|

*tato muhūrte brāhme tu tasyāścakruḥ surastriyaḥ \|*  
*nānāmaṅgalasaṃdohān yathāvatkramapūrvakam \|\| 427 \|\|*

*divyamaṇḍanamaṅgānāṃ mandire bahumaṅgale \|*  
*upāsata giriṃ mūrtā ṛtavaḥ sārvakāmikāḥ \|\| 428 \|\|*

427-428. Afterwards in. the auspicious moment in early morning (Brahma muhurta), the dear friends of the Devi performed various auspicious ceremonies, adorned Her body with various ornaments and took Her to a temple filled with auspicious things, where the seasons, incarnate in their proper forms, worshipped Himachala.

## \|\| 154.431-433 \|\|

*upatasthurnagāścāpi kalpakāmamahādrumāḥ \|*  
*oṣadhyo mūrtimatyaśca divyauṣadhisamanvitāḥ \|\| 431 \|\|*

*rasāśca dhātavaścaiva sarve śailasya kiṃkarāḥ \|*  
*kiṃkarāstasya śailasya vyagrāścājñānuvartinaḥ \|\| 432 \|\|*

*nadyaḥ samudrā nikhilāḥ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yat \|*  
*tatsarvaṃ himaśailasya mahimānamavardhayat \|\| 433 \|\|*

431-433. The wind accompanied by clouds came and began to work as sweepers and the Goddess Lakshmi came Herself in all Her riches. poste and affluence pervaded everywhere. Fortune and success reigned. Chintamani and other gems, Kalpa trees and trees yielding all desires, appeared in Himalaya’s room. All the mountains and Divine herbs presented themselves there personified. The Rasas and the ores also summed up there and acted as servants. The rivers and the oceans and sll things, moveable and immoveable, also went there personified and the whole Sthavara and the Jangama worlds added to the lustre of that mountain.

**Комментарий:**

Note. — ... = Philosopher's stone. ... = Sap, Potion, taste, delight, Pathos. They are sin in point of taste, viz.:— ... They are eight in point of sentiment, viz.:— ... But sometimes their number is nine by the ... being added and sometimes .... is also added making them ten.

## \|\| 154.434-437 \|\|

*abhavanmunayo nāgā yakṣagandharvakiṃnarāḥ \|*  
*śaṃkarasyāpi vibudhā gandhamādanaparvate \|\| 434 \|\|*

*sarve maṇḍanasaṃbhārās tasthurnirmalamūrtayaḥ \|*  
*śarvasyāpi jaṭājūṭe candrakhaṇḍaṃ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 435 \|\|*

*babandha praṇayodāra-visphāritavilocanaḥ \|*  
*kapālamālāṃ vipulāṃ cāmuṇḍā mūrdhnyabandhayat \|\| 436 \|\|*

*uvāca cāpi vacanaṃ putraṃ janaya śaṃkara \|*  
*yo daityendrakulaṃ hatvā māṃ raktaistarpayiṣyati \|\| 437 \|\|*

434-437. The seers, the serpents, the Yakshas, the Gandharvas, the Kinnaras, and the Devas, all, came to the Gandhamadan mount, well arranged and became the attendants of Shiva and assuming beautiful forms, began to arrange the pandal. Brahma very lovingly decorated the plaited hair of, the Lord with the moon and infused love and generosity into the fire of the Third Eye of the Lord. The Goddess Chamunda tied several garlands of heads on Her neck and said to Shiva, “Pray, beget a son who may be the destroyer of Tarakasura and thus I may be gratified with the blood of the demons.

## \|\| 154.438 \|\|

*saurir jvalacchiroratna-mukuṭaṃ cānalolbaṇam \|*  
*bhujagābharaṇaṃ gṛhya sadjaṃ śaṃbhoḥ puro 'bhavat \|\| 438 \|\|*

438\. Vishnu, then, stood before the Lord holding the crown decorated with fiery serpents.

## \|\| 154.139-440 \|\|

*kiṃcitkampitamūrdhā tu vākyaṃ novāca kiṃcana \|*  
*tataḥ punaruvācedaṃ vākyaṃ mātā sutāṃ tadā \|\| 139 \|\|*

*vatse vandaya devarṣiṃ tato dāsyāmi te śubham \|*  
*ratnakrīḍanakaṃ ramyaṃ sthāpitaṃ yacciraṃ mayā \|\| 140 \|\|*

*ityuktā tu tato vegād uddhṛtya caraṇau tadā \|*  
*vavande mūrdhni saṃdhāya karapaṅkajakuḍmalam \|\| 141 \|\|*

*kṛte tu vandane tasyā mātā sakhīmukhena tu \|*  
*codayāmāsa śanakais tasyāḥ saubhāgyaśaṃsinām \|\| 142 \|\|*

*śarīralakṣaṇānāṃ tu vijñānāya tu kautukāt \|*  
*strīsvabhāvādyadduhituś cintāṃ hṛdi samudvahan \|\| 143 \|\|*

*jñātvā tadiṅgitaṃ śailo mahiṣyā hṛdayena tu \|*  
*anudgīrṇo 'kṣatirmene ramyametadupasthitam \|\| 144 \|\|*

*coditaḥ śailamahiṣī-sakhyā munivarastadā \|*  
*smitānano mahābhāgo vākyaṃ provāca nāradaḥ \|\| 145 \|\|*

*na jāto 'syāḥ patirbhadre lakṣaṇaiśca vivarjitā \|*  
*uttānahastā satataṃ caraṇairvyabhicāribhiḥ \|*  
*svachāyayā bhaviṣyeyaṃ kimanyadbahu bhāṣyate \|\| 146 \|\|*

*śrutvaitatsaṃbhramāviṣṭo dhvastadhairyo mahābalaḥ \|*  
*nāradaṃ pratyuvācātha sāśrukaṇṭho mahāgiriḥ \|\| 147 \|\|*

*himavānuvāca*  
*saṃsārasyātidoṣasya durvijñeyā gatiryataḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭyāṃ cāvaṣyabhāvinyāṃ kenāpyatiśayātmanā \|\| 148 \|\|*

*kartrā praṇītā maryādā sthitā saṃsāriṇāmiyam \|*  
*yo jāyate hi yadbījo janituḥ sa hyasārthakaḥ \|\| 149 \|\|*

*janitā cāpi jātasya na kaściditi yatsphuṭam \|*  
*svakarmaṇaiva jāyante vividhā bhūtajātayaḥ \|\| 150 \|\|*

*aṇḍajo hyaṇḍajādjātaḥ punarjāyeta mānavaḥ \|*  
*mānuṣācca sarīsṛpyāṃ manuṣyatvena jāyate \|\| 151 \|\|*

*tatrāpi jātau śreṣṭhāyāṃ dharmasyotkarṣaṇena tu \|*  
*aputrajanminaḥ śeṣāḥ prāṇinaḥ samavasthitāḥ \|\| 152 \|\|*

*manujāstatra jāyante yato na gṛhadharmiṇaḥ \|*  
*krameṇāśramasaṃprāptir brahmacārivratādanu \|\| 153 \|\|*

*tasya karturniyogena saṃsāro yena vardhitaḥ \|*  
*saṃsārasya kuto vṛddhiḥ sarve syuryadatigrahāḥ \|\| 154 \|\|*

*ataḥ kartrā tu śāstreṣu sutalābhaḥ praśaṃsitaḥ \|*  
*prāṇināṃ mohanārthāya narakatrāṇasaṃśrayāt \|\| 155 \|\|*

*striyā virahitā sṛṣṭir jantūnāṃ nopapadyate \|*  
*strījātistu prakṛtyaiva kṛpaṇā dainyabhāṣiṇī \|*  
*śāstrālocanasāmarthyam udjhitaṃ tāsu vedhasā \|\| 156 \|\|*

*śāstreṣūktamasaṃdigdhaṃ bahuvāraṃ mahāphalam \|*  
*daśaputrasamā kanyā yā na syācchīlavarjitā \|\| 157 \|\|*

*vākyametatphalabhraṣṭaṃ puṃsi glānikaraṃ param \|*  
*kanyā hi kṛpaṇā śocyā piturduḥkhavivardhinī \|\| 158 \|\|*

*yāpi syātpūrṇasarvāḍhyā patiputradhanādibhiḥ \|*  
*kiṃ punardurbhagā hīnā patiputradhanādibhiḥ \|\| 159 \|\|*

*tvaṃ coktavānsutāyā me śarīre doṣasaṃgraham \|*  
*aho muhyāmi śuṣyāmi glāmi sīdāmi nārada \|\| 160 \|\|*

*auktamatha vaktavyam aprāpyamapi sāṃpratam \|*  
*anugraheṇa me chinddhi duḥkhaṃ kanyāśrayaṃ mune \|\| 161 \|\|*

*paricchinne 'pyasaṃdigdhe manaḥ paribhavāśrayam \|*  
*tṛṣṇā muṣṇāti niṣṇātā phalalobhāśrayāśubhā \|\| 162 \|\|*

*strīṇāṃ hi paramaṃ janma kulānāmubhayātmanām \|*  
*ihāmutra sukhāyoktaṃ satpatiprāptisaṃjñitam \|\| 163 \|\|*

*durlabhaḥ satpatiḥ strīṇāṃ viguṇo 'pi patiḥ kila \|*  
*na prāpyate vinā puṇyaiḥ patirnāryā kadācana \|\| 164 \|\|*

*yato niḥsādhano dharmaḥ parimāṇodjhitā ratiḥ \|*  
*dhanaṃ jīvitaparyāptaṃ patyau nāryāḥ pratiṣṭhitam \|\| 165 \|\|*

*nirdhano durbhago mūrkhaḥ sarvalakṣaṇavarjitaḥ \|*  
*daivataṃ paramaṃ nāryāḥ patiruktaḥ sadaiva hi \|\| 166 \|\|*

*tvayā coktaṃ hi devarṣe na jāto 'syāḥ patiḥ kila \|*  
*etaddaurbhāgyamatulam asaṃkhyaṃ guru duḥsaham \|\| 167 \|\|*

*carācare bhūtasarge yadadyāpi ca no mune \|*  
*na sa jāta iti brūṣe tena me vyākulaṃ manaḥ \|\| 168 \|\|*

*manuṣyadevajātīnāṃ śubhāśubhanivedakam \|*  
*lakṣaṇaṃ hastapādādau vihitairlakṣaṇaiḥ kila \|\| 169 \|\|*

*seyam uttānahasteti tvayoktā munipuṃgava \|*  
*uttānahastatā proktā yācatāmeva nityadā \|\| 170 \|\|*

*śubhodayānāṃ dhanyānāṃ na kadācitprayacchatām \|*  
*svachāyayāsyāścaraṇau tvayoktau vyabhicāriṇau \|\| 171 \|\|*

*tatrāpi śreyasāṃ hyāśā mune na pratibhāti naḥ \|*  
*śarīralakṣaṇāścānye pṛthakphalanivedinaḥ \|\| 172 \|\|*

*saubhāgyadhanaputrāuḥ patilābhānuśaṃsanam \|*  
*taiśca sarvairvihīneyaṃ tvamāttha munipuṃgava \|\| 173 \|\|*

*tvaṃ me sarvaṃ vijānāsi satyavāgasi cāpyataḥ \|*  
*muhyāmi muniśārdūla hṛdayaṃ dīryatīva me \|\| 174 \|\|*

*ityuktvā virataḥ śailo mahāduḥkhavicāraṇāt \|*  
*śrutvaitadakhilaṃ tasmāc chailarājamukhāmbujāt \|*  
*smitapūrvamuvācedaṃ nārado devacoditaḥ \|\| 175 \|\|*

*nārada uvāca*  
*harṣasthāne 'pi mahati tvayā duḥkhaṃ nirūpyate \|*  
*aparicchinnavākyārthe mohaṃ yāsi mahāgire \|\| 176 \|\|*

*imāṃ śṛṇu giraṃ matto rahasyapariniṣṭhitām \|*  
*samāhito mahāśaila mayoktasya vicāraṇe \|\| 177 \|\|*

*na jāto 'syāḥ patirdevyā yanmayoktaṃ himācala \|*  
*na sa jāto mahādevo bhūtabhavyabhavodbhavaḥ \|*  
*śaraṇyaḥ śāśvataḥ śāstā śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ \|\| 178 \|\|*

*brahmaviṣṇvindramunayo janmamṛtyujarārditāḥ \|*  
*tasyaite parameśasya sarve krīḍanakā gire \|\| 179 \|\|*

*āste brahmā tadicchātaḥ sambhūto bhuvanaprabhuḥ \|*  
*viṣṇuryuge uge jāto nānājātirmahātanuḥ \|\| 180 \|\|*

*manyase māyayā jātaṃ viṣṇuṃ cāpi uge uge \|*  
*ātmano na vināśo 'sti sthāvarānte 'pi bhūdhara \|\| 181 \|\|*

*saṃsāre jāyamānasya bhriyamāṇasya dehinaḥ \|*  
*naṣyate deha evātra nātmano nāśa ucyate \|\| 182 \|\|*

*brahmādisthāvarānto 'yaṃ saṃsāro yaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|*  
*sa janmamṛtyuduḥkhārto hy avaśaḥ parivartate \|\| 183 \|\|*

*mahādevo 'calaḥ sthāṇur na jāto janako 'jaraḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyati patiḥ so 'syā jagannātho nirāmayaḥ \|\| 184 \|\|*

*yaduktaṃ ca mayā devī lakṣaṇairvarjitā tava \|*  
*śṛṇu tasyāpi vākyasya samyaktvena vicāraṇam \|\| 185 \|\|*

*lakṣaṇaṃ daiviko hyaṅkaḥ śarīrāvayavāśrayaḥ \|*  
*sarvāurdhanasaubhāgya-parimāṇaprakāśakaḥ \|\| 186 \|\|*

*anantasyāprameyasya saubhāgyasyāsya bhūdhara \|*  
*naivāṅko lakṣaṇākāraḥ śarīre saṃvidhīyate \|\| 187 \|\|*

*ato 'syā lakṣaṇaṃ gātre śaila nāsti mahāmate \|*  
*yathāhamuktavānasyā hy uttānakaratāṃ sadā \|\| 188 \|\|*

*uttāno varadaḥ pāṇir eṣa devyāḥ sadaiva tu \|*  
*surāsuramunivrāta-varadeyaṃ bhaviṣyati \|\| 189 \|\|*

*yathā proktaṃ tadā pādau svacchāyāvyabhicāriṇau \|*  
*asyāḥ śṛṇu mamātrāpi vāgyuktiṃ śailasattama \|\| 190 \|\|*

*caraṇau padmasaṃkāśāv asyāḥ svacchanakhodjvalau \|*  
*surāsurāṇāṃ namatāṃ kirīṭamaṇikāntibhiḥ \|\| 191 \|\|*

*vicitravarṇairbhāsantau svacchāyāpratibimbitau \|*  
*bhāryā jagadgurorhyeṣā vṛṣāṅkasya mahīdhara \|\| 192 \|\|*

*jananī lokadharmasya sambhūtā bhūtabhāvanī \|*  
*śiveyaṃ pāvanāyaiva tvatkṣetre pāvakadyutiḥ \|\| 193 \|\|*

*tadyathā śīghramevaiṣāṃ yogaṃ yāyātpinākinā \|*  
*tathā vidheyaṃ vidhivat tvayā śailendrasattama \|*  
*atyantaṃ hi mahatkāryaṃ devānāṃ himabhūdhara \|\| 194 \|\|*

*sūta uvāca*  
*evaṃ śrutvā tu śailendro nāradātsarvameva hi \|*  
*ātmānaṃ sa punarjātaṃ mene menāpatistadā \|\| 195 \|\|*

*namaskṛtya vṛṣāṅkāya tadā devāya dhīmate \|*  
*uvāca so 'pi saṃhṛṣṭo nāradaṃ tu himācalaḥ \|\| 196 \|\|*

*himavānuvāca*  
*dustarānnarakādghorād uddhṛto 'smi tvayā mune \|*  
*pātālādahamuddhṛtya saptalokādhipaḥ kṛtaḥ \|\| 197 \|\|*

*himācalo 'smi vikhyātas tvayā munivarādhunā \|*  
*himācale 'calaguṇāṃ prāpito 'smi samunnatim \|\| 198 \|\|*

*ānandadivasāhāri hṛdayaṃ me 'dhunā mune \|*  
*nādhyavasyati kṛtyānāṃ pravibhāgavicāraṇam \|*  
*yadi vācāmadhīśaḥ syāṃ tvadguṇānāṃ vicāraṇe \|\| 199 \|\|*

*bhavadvidhānāṃ niyatam amoghaṃ darśanaṃ mune \|*  
*tavāsmānprati cāpalyaṃ vyaktaṃ mama mahāmune \|\| 200 \|\|*

*bhavadbhireva kṛtyo 'haṃ nivāsāyātmarūpiṇām \|*  
*munīnāṃ devatānāṃ ca svayaṃkartāpi kalmaṣam \|\| 201 \|\|*

*tathāpi vastunyekasminn ājñā me sampradīyatām \|*  
*ityuktavati śailendre sa tadā harṣanirbhare \|\| 202 \|\|*

*tathā ca nārado vākyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvamiti prabho \|*  
*surakārye ya evārthas tavāpi sumahattaraḥ \|\| 203 \|\|*

*ityuktvā nāradaḥ śīghraṃ jagāma tridivaṃ prati \|*  
*sa gatvā śakrabhavanam amareśaṃ dadarśa ha \|\| 204 \|\|*

*tato 'bhirūpe sa munir upaviṣṭo mahāsane \|*  
*pṛṣṭaḥ śakreṇa provāca himajāsaṃśrayāṃ kathām \|\| 205 \|\|*

*nārada uvāca*  
*samūhya yattu kartavyaṃ tanmayā kṛtameva hi \|*  
*kiṃ tu pañcaśarasyaiva samayo 'yamupasthitaḥ \|\| 206 \|\|*

*ityukto devarājastu muninā kāryadarśinā \|*  
*cūtāṅkurāstraṃ sasmāra bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ \|\| 207 \|\|*

*saṃsmṛtastu tadā kṣipraṃ sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā \|*  
*upatasthe ratiutaḥ savilāso jhaṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*prādurbhūtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā śakraḥ provāca sādaram \|\| 208 \|\|*

*śakra uvāca*  
*upadeśena bahunā kiṃ tvāṃ prati vade priyam \|*  
*manobhavo 'si tena tvaṃ vetsi bhūtamanogatam \|\| 209 \|\|*

*tadyathārthakameva tvaṃ kuru nākasadāṃ priyam \|*  
*śaṃkaraṃ yojaya kṣipraṃ giriputryā manobhava \|*  
*saṃyuto madhunā caiva ṛturājena durjaya \|\| 210 \|\|*

*ityukto madanastena śakreṇa svārthasiddhaye \|*  
*provāca pañcabāṇo 'tha vākyaṃ bhītaḥ śatakratum \|\| 211 \|\|*

*kāma uvāca*  
*anayā devasāmagryā munidānavabhīmayā \|*  
*duḥsādhyaḥ śaṃkaro devaḥ kiṃ na vetsi jagatprabho \|\| 212 \|\|*

*tasya devasya vettha tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ tu yadavyayam \|*  
*prāyaḥ prasādaḥ kopo 'pi sarvo hi mahatāṃ mahān \|\| 213 \|\|*

*sarvopabhogasārā hi sundaryaḥ svargasaṃbhavāḥ \|*  
*adhyāśritaṃ ca yatsaukhyaṃ bhavatā naṣṭaceṣṭitam \|\| 214 \|\|*

*pramādādatha vibhraśyed īśaṃ prati vicintyatām \|*  
*prāgeva ceha dṛṣyante bhūtānāṃ kāryasaṃbhavāḥ \|\| 215 \|\|*

*viśeṣaṃ kāṅkṣatāṃ śakra sāmānyādbhraṃśanaṃ phalam \|*  
*śrutvaitadvacanaṃ śakras tamuvācāmarairyutaḥ \|\| 216 \|\|*

*śakra uvāca*  
*vayaṃ pramāṇāste hyatra ratikānta na saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*saṃdeśena vinā śaktir apakārasya neṣyate \|*  
*kasyacic ca kvaciddṛṣṭaṃ sāmarthyaṃ na tu sarvataḥ \|\| 217 \|\|*

*ityuktaḥ prayayau kāmaḥ sakhāyaṃ madhumāśritaḥ \|*  
*ratiukto jagāmāśu prasthaṃ tu himabhūbhṛtaḥ \|\| 218 \|\|*

*sa tu tatrākaroccintāṃ kāryasyopāyapūrvikām \|*  
*mahārthā ye hi niṣkampā manasteṣāṃ sudurjayam \|\| 219 \|\|*

*tadādāveva saṃkṣobhya niyataṃ sujayo bhavet \|*  
*saṃsiddhiṃ prāpnuuścaiva pūrvaṃ saṃśodhya mānasam \|\| 220 \|\|*

*kathaṃ ca vividhairbhāvair dveṣānugamanaṃ vinā \|*  
*krodhaḥ krūratarāsaṅgād bhīṣaṇerṣyāṃ mahāsakhīm \|\| 221 \|\|*

*cāpalyamūrdhni vidhvasta-dhairyādhārāṃ mahābalām \|*  
*tāmasya viniyokṣyāmi manaso vikṛtiṃ parām \|\| 222 \|\|*

*pidhāya dhairyadvārāṇi saṃtoṣamapakṛṣya ca \|*  
*avagantuṃ hi māṃ tatra na kaścidatipaṇḍitaḥ \|\| 223 \|\|*

*vikalpamātrāvasthāne vairūpyaṃ manaso bhavet \|*  
*paścānmūlakriyārambha-gambhīrāvartadustaraḥ \|\| 224 \|\|*

*hariṣyāmi harasyāhaṃ tapastasya sthirātmanaḥ \|*  
*indriyagrāmamāvṛtya ramyasādhanasaṃvidhiḥ \|\| 225 \|\|*

*cintayitveti madano bhūtabhartustadāśramam \|*  
*jagāma jagatīsāraṃ saraladrumavedikam \|\| 226 \|\|*

*śāntasattvasamākīrṇam acalaprāṇisaṃkulam \|*  
*nānāpuṣpalatājālaṃ gaganasthagaṇeśvaram \|\| 227 \|\|*

*nirvyagravṛṣabhādhyuṣṭa-nīlaśādvalasānukam \|*  
*tatrāpaṣyattrinetrasya ramyaṃ kaṃciddvitīyakam \|\| 228 \|\|*

*vīrakaṃ lokavīreśam īśānasadṛśadyutim \|*  
*yakṣakuṅkumakiñjalka-puñjapiṅgajaṭāsaṭam \|\| 229 \|\|*

*vetrapāṇinam avyagram ugrabhogīndrabhūṣaṇam \|*  
*tato nimīlitonnidra-padmapatrābhalocanam \|\| 230 \|\|*

*prekṣamāṇamṛjusthānaṃ nāsikāgraṃ sulocanaiḥ \|*  
*śravastarasasiṃhendra-carmalambottarīyakam \|\| 231 \|\|*

*śravaṇāhiphalanmukta-niḥśvāsānalapiṅgalam \|*  
*preṅkhatkapālaparyanta-tumbilambijaṭācayam \|\| 232 \|\|*

*kṛtavāsukiparyaṅka-nābhimūlaniveśitam \|*  
*brahmāñjalisthapucchāgra-nibaddhoragabhūṣaṇam \|\| 233 \|\|*

*dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ kāmaḥ kramaprāptāntikaṃ śanaiḥ \|*  
*tato bhramarajhaṅkāra-mālambidrumasānukam \|\| 234 \|\|*

*praviṣṭaḥ karṇarandhreṇa bhavasya madano manaḥ \|*  
*śaṃkarastamathākarṇya madhuraṃ madanāśrayam \|\| 235 \|\|*

*sasmāra dakṣaduhitāraṃ dayitāṃ raktamānasaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ sā tasya śanakais tirobhūyātinirmalā \|\| 236 \|\|*

*samādhibhāvanā tasthau lakṣyapratyakṣarūpiṇī \|*  
*tatastanmayatāṃ yātaḥ pratyūhāpihitāśayaḥ \|\| 237 \|\|*

*vaśitvena bubodheśo vikṛtiṃ madanātmikām \|*  
*īṣatkopasamāviṣṭo dhairyamālambya dhūrjaṭiḥ \|\| 238 \|\|*

*nirāse madanasthityā yogamāyāsamāvrataḥ \|*  
*sa tayā māyayāviṣṭo jajvāla madanastataḥ \|\| 239 \|\|*

*icchāśarīro durjeyo roṣadoṣamahāśrayaḥ \|*  
*hṛdayānnirgataḥ so 'tha vāsanāvyasanātmakaḥ \|\| 240 \|\|*

*bahiḥsthalaṃ samālambya hy upatasthau jhaṣadhvajaḥ \|*  
*anuyāto 'tha hṛdyena mitreṇa madhunā saha \|\| 241 \|\|*

*sahakāratarau dṛṣṭvā mṛdumārutanirdhutam \|*  
*stabakaṃ madano ramyaṃ haravakṣasi satvaram \|\| 242 \|\|*

*mumoca mohanaṃ nāma mārgaṇaṃ makaradhvajaḥ \|*  
*śivasya hṛdaye śuddhe nāśaśālī mahāśaraḥ \|\| 243 \|\|*

*papāta paruṣaprāṃśuḥ puṣpabāṇo vimohanaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ karaṇasaṃdeho viddhastu hṛdaye bhavaḥ \|\| 244 \|\|*

*babhūva bhūdharaupamya-dhairyo 'pi madanonmukhaḥ \|*  
*tataḥ prabhutvādbhāvānāṃ nāveśaṃ samapadyata \|\| 245 \|\|*

*bāhyaṃ bahu samāsādya pratyūhaprasavātmakam \|*  
*tataḥ kopānalodbhūta-ghorahuṅkārabhīṣaṇe \|\| 246 \|\|*

*babhūva vadane netraṃ tṛtīyamanalākulam \|*  
*rudrasya raudravapuṣo jagatsaṃhārabhairavam \|\| 247 \|\|*

*tadantikasthe madane vyasphārayata dhūrjaṭiḥ \|*  
*tannetravisphuliṅgena krośatāṃ nākavāsinām \|\| 248 \|\|*

*gamito bhasmasāttūrṇaṃ kandarpaḥ kāmidarpakaḥ \|*  
*sa tu taṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā haranetrodbhavo 'nalaḥ \|\| 249 \|\|*

*vyajṛmbhata jagaddagdhuṃ jvālāhuṅkāraghasmaraḥ \|*  
*tato bhavo jagaddhetor vyabhavadjātavedasam \|\| 250 \|\|*

*sahakāre madhau candre sumanaḥsu pareṣvapi \|*  
*bhṛṅgeṣu kokilāsyeṣu vibhāgena smarānalam \|\| 251 \|\|*

*sa bāhyāntaraviddhena hareṇa smaramārgaṇaḥ \|*  
*rāgasnehasamiddhāntar-dhāvaṃstīvrahutāśanaḥ \|\| 252 \|\|*

*vibhaktalokasaṃkṣobha-karo durvārajṛmbhitaḥ \|*  
*samprāpya snehasaṃpṛktaṃ kāmināṃ hṛdayaṃ kila \|\| 253 \|\|*

*jvalatyaharniśaṃ bhīmo duścikitsyamukhātmakaḥ \|*  
*vilokya harahuṅkāra-jvālābhasmakṛtaṃ smaram \|\| 254 \|\|*

*vilalāpa ratiḥ krūraṃ bandhunā madhunā saha \|*  
*tato vilapya bahuśo madhunā parisāntvitā \|\| 255 \|\|*

*jagāma śaraṇaṃ devam indumauliṃ trilocanam \|*  
*bhṛṅgānuyātāṃ saṃgṛhya puṣpitāṃ sahakārajām \|\| 256 \|\|*

*latāṃ pavitrakasthāne pāṇau parabhṛtāṃ sakhīm \|*  
*nirbadhya tu jaṭājūṭaṃ kuṭilair alakai ratiḥ \|\| 257 \|\|*

*uddhvalya gātraṃ śubhreṇa hṛdyena smarabhasmanā \|*  
*jānubhyāmavanīṃ gatvā provācenduvibhūṣaṇam \|\| 258 \|\|*

*ratiruvāca*  
*namaḥ śivāyāstu nirāmayāya namaḥ śivāyāstu manomayāya \|*  
*namaḥ śivāyāstu surārcitāya tubhyaṃ sadā bhaktakṛpāparāya \|\| 259 \|\|*

*namo bhavāyāstu bhavodbhavāya namo 'stu te dhvastamanobhavāya \|*  
*namo 'stu te gūḍhamahāvratāya namo 'stu māyāgahanāśrayāya \|\| 260 \|\|*

*namo 'stu śarvāya namaḥ śivāya namo 'stu siddhāya purātanāya \|*  
*namo 'stu kālāya namaḥ kalāya namo 'stu te jñānavarapradāya \|\| 261 \|\|*

*namo 'stu te kālakalātigāya namo nisargāmalabhūṣaṇāya \|*  
*namo 'stvameyāndhakamardakāya namaḥ śaraṇyāya namo 'guṇāya \|\| 262 \|\|*

*namo 'stu te bhīmagaṇānugāya namo 'stu nānābhuvanādikartre \|*  
*namo 'stu nānājagatāṃ vidhātre namo 'stu te citraphalaprayoktre \|\| 263 \|\|*

*sarvāvasāne hyavināśanetre namo 'stu citrādhvarabhāgabhoktre \|*  
*namo 'stu bhaktābhimatapradātre namaḥ sadā te bhavasaṅgahartre \|\| 264 \|\|*

*anantarūpāya sadaiva tubhyam asahyakopāya namo 'stu tubhyam \|*  
*śaśāṅkacihnāya sadaiva tubhyam ameyamānāya namaḥ stutāya \|\| 265 \|\|*

*vṛṣendrayānāya purāntakāya namaḥ prasiddhāya mahauṣadhāya \|*  
*namo 'stu bhaktyābhimatapradāya namo 'stu sarvārtiharāya tubhyam \|\| 266 \|\|*

*carācarācāravicāravaryam ācāryam utprekṣitabhūtasargam \|*  
*tvāmindumauliṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannā priyāprameyaṃ mahatāṃ maheśam \|\| 267 \|\|*

*prayaccha me kāmayaśaḥsamṛddhiṃ punaḥ prabho jīvatu kāmadevaḥ \|*  
*priyaṃ vinā tvāṃ priyajīviteṣu tvatto 'paraḥ ko bhuvaneṣvihāsti \|\| 268 \|\|*

*prabhuḥ priyāyāḥ prasavaḥ priyāṇāṃ praṇītaparyāyaparāparārthaḥ \|*  
*tvamevameko bhuvanasya nātho dayālurunmūlitabhaktabhītiḥ \|\| 269 \|\|*

*sūta uvāca*  
*itthaṃ stutaḥ śaṃkara īḍya īśo vṛṣākapirmanmathakāntayā tu \|*  
*tutoṣa doṣākarakhaṇḍadhārī uvāca caināṃ madhuraṃ nirīkṣya \|\| 270 \|\|*

*śaṃkara uvāca*  
*bhaviteti ca kāmo 'yaṃ kālātkānto 'cirādapi \|*  
*anaṅga iti lokeṣu sa vikhyātiṃ gamiṣyati \|\| 271 \|\|*

*ityuktā śirasāvandya giriśaṃ kāmavallabhā \|*  
*jagāmopavanaṃ ramyaṃ ratistu himabhūbhṛtaḥ \|\| 272 \|\|*

*ruroda cāpi bahuśo dīnā ramye sthale tu sā \|*  
*maraṇavyavasāyāttu nivṛttā sā harājñayā \|\| 273 \|\|*

*atha nāradavākyena codito himabhūdharaḥ \|*  
*kṛtābharaṇasaṃskārāṃ kṛtakautukamaṅgalām \|\| 274 \|\|*

*svargapuṣpakṛtāpīḍāṃ śubhracīnāṃśukāmbarām \|*  
*śarābhyāṃ saṃyutāṃ śailo gṛhītvā svasutāṃ tataḥ \|\| 275 \|\|*

*jagāma śubhayogena tadā sampūrṇamānasaḥ \|*  
*sakānanānyupākramya vanānyupavanāni ca \|\| 276 \|\|*

*dadarśa rudatīṃ nārīm apratarkyamahaujasam \|*  
*rūpeṇāsadṛśīṃ loke ramyeṣu vanasānuṣu \|\| 277 \|\|*

*kautukena parāmṛṣya tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rudatīṃ giriḥ \|*  
*upasarpya tatastasyā nikaṭe so 'bhyapṛcchata \|\| 278 \|\|*

*himavānuvāca*  
*kāsi kasyāsi kalyāṇi kimarthaṃ cāpi rodiṣi \|*  
*naitadalpamahaṃ manye kāraṇaṃ lokasundari \|\| 279 \|\|*

*sā tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā uvāca madhunā saha \|*  
*rudatī śokajananaṃ śvasatī dainyavardhanam \|\| 280 \|\|*

*ratiruvāca*  
*kāmasya dayitāṃ bhāryāṃ ratiṃ māṃ viddhi suvrata \|*  
*girāvasminmahābhāga giriśastapasi sthitaḥ \|\| 281 \|\|*

*tena pratyūharuṣṭena visphāryālokya locanam \|*  
*dagdho 'sau jhaṣaketustu mama kānto 'tivallabhaḥ \|\| 282 \|\|*

*ahaṃ tu śaraṇaṃ yātā taṃ devaṃ bhayavihvalā \|*  
*stutavatyatha saṃstutyā tato māṃ giriśo 'bravīt \|\| 283 \|\|*

*tuṣṭo 'haṃ kāmadayite kāmo 'yaṃ te bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tvatstutiṃ cāpyadhīyāno naro bhaktyā madāśrayaḥ \|*  
*lapsyate kāṅkṣitaṃ kāmaṃ nivartya maraṇāditaḥ \|\| 284 \|\|*

*pratīkṣantī ca tadvākyam āśāveśādibhirhyaham \|*  
*śarīraṃ parirakṣiṣye kaṃcitkālaṃ mahādyute \|\| 285 \|\|*

*ityuktastu tadā ratyā śailaḥ saṃbhramabhīṣitaḥ \|*  
*pāṇāvādāya hi sutāṃ gantumaicchatsvakaṃ puram \|\| 286 \|\|*

*bhāvino 'vaṣyabhāvitvād bhavitrī bhūtabhāvinī \|*  
*ladjamānā sakhimukhair uvāca pitaraṃ girim \|\| 287 \|\|*

*śailaduhitovāca*  
*durbhāgyeṇa śarīreṇa kiṃ mamānena kāraṇam \|*  
*kathaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ prāptaṃ sukhaṃ me sa patirbhavet \|\| 288 \|\|*

*tapobhiḥ prāpyate 'bhīṣṭaṃ nāsādhyaṃ hi tapasyataḥ \|*  
*durbhagatvaṃ vṛthā loko vahate sati sādhane \|\| 289 \|\|*

*jīvitāddurbhagācchreyo maraṇaṃ hyatapasyataḥ \|*  
*bhaviṣyāmi na saṃdeho niyamaiḥ śoṣaye tanum \|\| 290 \|\|*

*tapasi bhraṣṭasaṃdeha udyamo 'rthajigīṣayā \|*  
*sāhaṃ tapaḥ kariṣyāmi yadahaṃ prāpya durlabhā \|\| 291 \|\|*

*ityuktaḥ śailarājastu duhitrā snehaviklavaḥ \|*  
*uvāca vācā śailendraḥ snehagadgadavarṇayā \|\| 292 \|\|*

*himavānuvāca*  
*umeti capale putri na kṣamaṃ tāvakaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*soḍhuṃ kleśasvarūpasya tapasaḥ saumyadarśane \|\| 293 \|\|*

*bhāvīnyabhivicāryāṇi padārthāni sadaiva tu \|*  
*bhāvino 'rthā bhavantyeva haṭhenānicchato 'pi vā \|\| 294 \|\|*

*tasmānna tapasā te 'sti bāle kiṃcitprayojanam \|*  
*bhavanāyaiva gacchāmaś cintayiṣyāmi tatra vai \|\| 295 \|\|*

*ityuktā tu yadā naiva guhāyābhyeti śailajā \|*  
*tataḥ sa cintayāviṣṭo duhitāṃ praśaśaṃsa ca \|\| 296 \|\|*

*tato 'ntarikṣe divyā vāg abhūdbhuvanabhūtale \|*  
*umeti capale putri tvayoktā tanayā tataḥ \|\| 297 \|\|*

*umeti nāma tenāsyā bhuvaneṣu bhaviṣyati \|*  
*siddhiṃ ca mūrtimatyeṣā sādhayiṣyati cintitām \|\| 298 \|\|*

*iti śrutvā tu vacanam ākāśātkāśapāṇḍuraḥ \|*  
*anujñāya sutāṃ śailo jagāmāśu svamandiram \|\| 299 \|\|*

*sūta uvāca*  
*śailajāpi yayau śailam agamyamapi daivataiḥ \|*  
*sakhībhyāmanuyātā tu niyatā nagarājajā \|\| 300 \|\|*

*śṛṅgaṃ himavataḥ puṇyaṃ nānādhātuvibhūṣitam \|*  
*divyapuṣpalatākīrṇaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam \|\| 301 \|\|*

*nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ bhramarodghuṣṭapādapam \|*  
*divyaprasravaṇopetaṃ dīrghikābhiralaṃkṛtam \|\| 302 \|\|*

*nānāpakṣigaṇākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam \|*  
*jalajasthalajaiḥ puṣpaiḥ protphullairupaśobhitam \|\| 303 \|\|*

*citrakandarasaṃsthānaṃ guhāgṛhamanoharam \|*  
*vihaṅgasaṃghasaṃjuṣṭaṃ kalpapādapasaṃkaṭam \|\| 304 \|\|*

*tatrāpaṣyanmahāśākhaṃ śākhinaṃ haritacchadam \|*  
*sarvartukusumopetaṃ manorathaśatodjvalam \|\| 305 \|\|*

*nānāpuṣpasamākīrṇaṃ nānāvidhaphalānvitam \|*  
*nataṃ sūryasya rucibhir bhinnasaṃhṛtapallavam \|\| 306 \|\|*

*tatrāmbarāṇi saṃtyajya bhūṣaṇāni ca śailajā \|*  
*saṃvītā valkalairdivyair darbhanirmitamekhalā \|\| 307 \|\|*

*triḥsnātā pāṭalāhārā babhūva śaradāṃ śatam \|*  
*śatamekena śīrṇena parṇenāvartayattadā \|\| 308 \|\|*

*nirāhārā śataṃ sābhūt samānāṃ tapasāṃ nidhiḥ \|*  
*tata udvejitāḥ sarve prāṇinastattapo 'gninā \|\| 309 \|\|*

*tataḥ sasmāra bhagavān munīnsapta śatakratuḥ \|*  
*te samāgamya munayaḥ sarve samuditāstataḥ \|\| 310 \|\|*

*pūjitāśca mahendreṇa papracchustaṃ prayojanam \|*  
*kimarthaṃ tu suraśreṣṭha saṃsmṛtāstu vayaṃ tvayā \|\| 311 \|\|*

*śakraḥ provāca śṛṇvantu bhagavantaḥ prayojanam \|*  
*himācale tapo ghoraṃ tapyate bhūdharātmajā \|*  
*tasyā hyabhimataṃ kāmaṃ bhavantaḥ kartumarhatha \|\| 312 \|\|*

*tataḥ samāpatandevyā jagadarthaṃ tvarānvitāḥ \|*  
*tathetyuktvā tu śailendraṃ siddhasaṃghātasevitam \|\| 313 \|\|*

*ūcurāgatya munayas tāmatho madhurākṣaram \|*  
*putri kiṃ te vyavasitaḥ kāmaḥ kamalalocane \|\| 314 \|\|*

*tānuvāca tato devī saladjā gauravānmunīn \|*  
*tapasyato mahābhāgāḥ prāpya maune bhavādṛśān \|\| 315 \|\|*

*vandanāya niuktā dhīḥ pāvayatyavikalpitam \|*  
*praśnonmukhatvādbhavatāṃ uktamāsanamāditaḥ \|\| 316 \|\|*

*upaviṣṭāḥ śramonmuktās tataḥ prakṣyatha māmataḥ \|*  
*ityuktvā sā tataścakre kṛtāsanaparigrahān \|\| 317 \|\|*

*sā tu tānvidhivatpūjyān pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|*  
*uvācādityasaṃkāśān munīnsapta satī śanaiḥ \|\| 318 \|\|*

*tyaktvā vratātmakaṃ maunaṃ maunaṃ jagrāha hrīmayam \|*  
*bhāvaṃ tasyāstu maunāntaṃ tasyāḥ saptarṣayo yathā \|\| 319 \|\|*

*gauravādhīnatāṃ prāptāḥ papracchustāṃ punastathā \|*  
*sāpi gauravagarbheṇa manasā cāruhāsinī \|\| 320 \|\|*

*munīñśāntakathālāpān prekṣya provāca vāgyamam \|*  
*bhagavanto vijānanti prāṇināṃ mānasaṃ hitam \|\| 321 \|\|*

*manogatībhiratyarthaṃ kadarthante hi dehinaḥ \|*  
*kecit tu nipuṇāstatra ghaṭante vibudhodyamaiḥ \|\| 322 \|\|*

*upāyairdurlabhānbhāvān prāpnuvanti hyatandritāḥ \|*  
*apare tu paricchinnā nānākārābhyupakramāḥ \|\| 323 \|\|*

*dehāntarārthamārambham āśrayanti hitapradam \|*  
*mama tvākāśasambhūta-puṣpadāmā vibhūṣitam \|\| 324 \|\|*

*vandhyā sutaṃ prāptukāmā manaḥ prasarate muhuḥ \|*  
*ahaṃ kila bhavaṃ devaṃ patiṃ prāptuṃ samudyatā \|\| 325 \|\|*

*prakṛtyaiva durādharṣaṃ tapasyantaṃ tu saṃprati \|*  
*surāsurairanirṇītaṃ paramārthakriyāśrayam \|\| 326 \|\|*

*sāṃprataṃ cāpi nirdagdha-madanaṃ vītarāgiṇam \|*  
*kathamārādhayedīśaṃ mādṛśī tādṛśaṃ śivam \|\| 327 \|\|*

*ityuktā munayaste tu sthiratāṃ manasastataḥ \|*  
*jñātumasyā vacaḥ procuḥ prakramātprakṛtārthakam \|\| 328 \|\|*

*munaya ūcuḥ*  
*dvividhaṃ tu sukhaṃ tāvat putri lokeṣu bhāvyate \|*  
*śarīrasyāsya saṃbhogaiś cetasaścāpi nirvṛtiḥ \|\| 329 \|\|*

*prakṛtyā sa tu digvāsā bhīmaḥ pitṛvaṇeśayaḥ \|*  
*kapālī bhikṣuko nagno virūpākṣaḥ sthirakriyaḥ \|\| 330 \|\|*

*pramattonmattakākāro bībhatsakṛtasaṃgrahaḥ \|*  
*yatinā tena kaste 'rtho mūrtānarthena kāṅkṣitaḥ \|\| 331 \|\|*

*yadi hyasya śarīrasya bhogamicchasi sāṃpratam \|*  
*tatkathaṃ te mahādevād bhayabhājo jugupsitāt \|\| 332 \|\|*

*sravadraktavasābhyakta-kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇāt \|*  
*śvasadugrabhujaṃgendra-kṛtabhūṣaṇabhīṣaṇāt \|\| 333 \|\|*

*śmaśānavāsino raudra-pramathānugatāt sati \|*  
*surendramukuṭavrāta-nighṛṣṭacaraṇo 'rihā \|\| 334 \|\|*

*harirasti jagaddhātā śrīkānto 'nantamūrtimān \|*  
*nātho yajñabhujāmasti tathendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ \|\| 335 \|\|*

*devatānāṃ nidhiścāsti jvalanaḥ sarvakāmakṛt \|*  
*vāurasti jagaddhātā yaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvadehinām \|\| 336 \|\|*

*tathā vaiśravaṇo rājā sarvārthamatimānvibhuḥ \|*  
*ebhya ekatamaṃ kasmān na tvaṃ samprāptumicchasi \|\| 337 \|\|*

*utānyadehasaṃprāptyā sukhaṃ te manasepsitam \|*  
*evametattavāpyatra prabhavo nākasaṃpadām \|*  
*asminneva parāḥ sarvāḥ kalyāṇaprāptayastava \|\| 338 \|\|*

*piturevāsti tatsarvaṃ surebhyo yanna vidyate \|*  
*atastatprāptaye kleśaḥ sa vāpyatrāphalastava \|\| 339 \|\|*

*prāyeṇa prārthito bhadre susvalpo hyatidurlabhaḥ \|*  
*asya te vidhiyogasya dhātā kartātra caiva hi \|\| 340 \|\|*

*sūta uvāca*  
*ityuktā sā tu kupitā munivaryeṣu śailajā \|*  
*uvāca koparaktākṣī sphuradbhirdaśanacchadaiḥ \|\| 341 \|\|*

*devyuvāca*  
*asadgrahasya kā prītir vyasanasya kva yantraṇā \|*  
*viparītārthaboddhāraḥ satpathe kena yojitāḥ \|\| 342 \|\|*

*evaṃ māṃ vettha duṣprajñāṃ hy asthānāsadgrahapriyām \|*  
*na māṃ prativicāro 'sti yatrehāsadgrahāvitau \|\| 343 \|\|*

*prajāpatisamāḥ sarve bhavantaḥ sarvadarśinaḥ \|*  
*nūnaṃ na vettha taṃ devaṃ śāśvataṃ jagataḥ prabhum \|\| 344 \|\|*

*ajamīśānamavyaktam ameyamahimodayam \|\| 345 \|\|*

*āstāṃ taddharmasadbhāva-saṃbodhastāvadadbhutaḥ \|*  
*viduryaṃ na haribrahma-pramukhā hi sureśvarāḥ \|\| 346 \|\|*

*yattasya vibhavātsvotthaṃ bhuvaneṣu vijṛmbhitam \|*  
*prakaṭaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tadapyatra na vettha kim \|\| 347 \|\|*

*kasyaitadgaganaṃ bhūritaḥ kasyāgniḥ kasya mārutaḥ \|*  
*kasya bhūḥ kasya varuṇaḥ kaścandrārkavilocanaḥ \|\| 348 \|\|*

*kasyārcayanti lokeṣu liṅgaṃ bhaktyā surāsurāḥ \|*  
*yaṃ bruvantīśvaraṃ devā vidhīndrādyā maharṣayaḥ \|\| 349 \|\|*

*prabhāvaṃ prabhavaṃ caiṣa teṣāmapi na vettha kim \|*  
*aditiḥ kasya māteyaṃ kasmādjāto janārdanaḥ \|\| 350 \|\|*

*aditeḥ kaṣyapādjātā devā nārāyaṇādayaḥ \|*  
*marīceḥ kaṣyapaḥ putro hy aditirdakṣaputrikā \|\| 351 \|\|*

*marīciścāpi dakṣaśca putrau tau brahmaṇaḥ kila \|*  
*brahmā hiraṇmayāttvaṇḍād divyasiddhivibhūtikam \|\| 352 \|\|*

*kasya prādurabhūddhyānāt prakṣubdhāḥ prākṛtāṃśakāḥ \|*  
*prakṛtau tu tṛtīyāyāṃ madhudviḍjananakriyā \|\| 353 \|\|*

*jātā sasarja ṣaḍvargān buddhipūrvān svakarmajān \|*  
*ajātako 'bhavadvedhā brahmaṇo 'vyaktajanmanaḥ \|\| 354 \|\|*

*yaḥ svayogena saṃkṣobhya prakṛtiṃ kṛtavānidam \|*  
*brahmaṇaḥ siddhasarvārtham aiśvaryaṃ lokakartṛtām \|\| 355 \|\|*

*vidurviṣṇvādayo yacca svamahimnā sadaiva hi \|*  
*kṛtvānyaṃ deham anyā dṛk tādṛk kṛtvā punarhariḥ \|\| 356 \|\|*

*kurute jagataḥ kṛtyam uttamādhamamadhyamam \|*  
*evameva hi saṃsāro yo janmamaraṇātmakaḥ \|\| 357 \|\|*

*karmaṇaśca phalaṃ hyetan nānārūpasamudbhavam \|*  
*atha nārāyaṇo devaḥ svakāṃ chāyāṃ samāśrayat \|\| 358 \|\|*

*tatpreritaḥ prakurute janma nānāprakārakam \|*  
*sāpi karmaṇa evoktā preraṇā vivaśātmanām \|\| 359 \|\|*

*yathonmādādijuṣṭasya matireva hi sā bhavet \|*  
*iṣṭānyeva yathārthāni viparītāni manyate \|\| 360 \|\|*

*lokasya vyavahāreṣu sṛṣṭeṣu sahate sadā \|*  
*dharmādharmaphalāvāptau viṣṇureva nibodhitaḥ \|\| 361 \|\|*

*athānāditvamasyāsti sāmānyāttu tadātmanā \|*  
*na hyasya jīvitaṃ dīrghaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dehe tu kutracit \|\| 362 \|\|*

*bhavadbhiryasya no dṛṣṭam antaragramathāpi vā \|*  
*dehināṃ dharma evaiṣa kvacidjāyetkacinmriyet \|\| 363 \|\|*

*kvacidgarbhagato naśyet kvacij jīvedjarāmayaḥ \|*  
*kvacitsamāḥ śataṃ jīvet kvacidbālye vipadyate \|\| 364 \|\|*

*śatāuḥ puruṣo yastu so 'nantaḥ svalpajanmanaḥ \|*  
*jīvito na mriyatyagre tasmātso 'mara ucyate \|\| 365 \|\|*

*adṛṣṭajanmanidhanā hy evaṃ viṣṇvādayo matāḥ \|*  
*etatsaṃśuddhamaiśvaryaṃ saṃsāre ko labhediha \|\| 366 \|\|*

*tatra kṣayādiyogāttu nānāścaryasvarūpiṇi \|*  
*tasmāddivaścarānsarvān malinānsvalpabhūtikān \|\| 367 \|\|*

*nāhaṃ bhadrāḥ kilecchāmi ṛte śarvātpinākinaḥ \|*  
*sthitaṃ ca tāratamyena prāṇināṃ paramaṃ tvidam \|\| 368 \|\|*

*dhībalaiśvaryakāryādi-pramāṇaṃ mahatāṃ mahat \|*  
*yasmānna kiṃcidaparaṃ sarvaṃ yasmātpravartate \|\| 369 \|\|*

*yasyaiśvaryamanādyantaṃ tamahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā \|*  
*eṣa me vyavasāyaśca dīrgho 'tiviparītakaḥ \|\| 370 \|\|*

*yāta vā tiṣṭhataivātha munayo madvidhāyakāḥ \|*  
*evaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ devyā munivarāstadā \|\| 371 \|\|*

*ānandāśruparītākṣāḥ sasvajustāṃ tapasvinīm \|*  
*ūcuśca paramaprītāḥ śailajāṃ madhuraṃ vacaḥ \|\| 372 \|\|*

*ṛṣaya ūcuḥ*  
*atyadbhutāsyaho putri jñānamūrtirivāmalā \|*  
*prasādayati no bhāvaṃ bhavabhāvapratiśrayāt \|\| 373 \|\|*

*nanu vidmo vayaṃ tasya devasyaiśvaryamadbhutam \|*  
*tvanniścayasya dṛḍhatāṃ vettuṃ vayamihāgatāḥ \|\| 374 \|\|*

*acirādeva tanvaṅgi kāmaste 'yaṃ bhaviṣyati \|*  
*kvādityasya prabhā yāti ratnebhyaḥ kva dyutiḥ pṛthak \|\| 375 \|\|*

*ko 'rtho varṇālikāvyaktaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ giriśaṃ vinā \|*  
*yāmo naikābhyupāyane tamabhyarthayituṃ vayam \|\| 376 \|\|*

*asmākamapi vai so 'rthaḥ sutarāṃ hṛdi vartate \|*  
*atastvameva sā buddhir yato nītistvameva hi \|\| 377 \|\|*

*ato niḥsaṃśayaṃ kāyaṃ śaṃkaro 'pi vidhāsyati \|*  
*ityuktvā pūjitā yātā munayo girikanyayā \|\| 378 \|\|*

*prayayurgiriśaṃ draṣṭuṃ prasthaṃ himavato mahat \|*  
*gaṅgāmbuplāvitātmānaṃ piṅgabaddhajaṭāsaṭam \|\| 379 \|\|*

*bhṛṅgānuyātapāṇistha-mandārakusumasrajam \|*  
*gireḥ samprāpya te prasthaṃ dadṛśuḥ śaṃkarāśramam \|\| 380 \|\|*

*praśāntāśeṣasattvaughaṃ navastimitakānanam \|*  
*niḥśabdākṣobhasalila-prapātaṃ sarvatodiśam \|\| 381 \|\|*

*tatrāpaṣyaṃstato dvāri vīrakaṃ vetrapāṇinam \|*  
*sapta te munayaḥ pūjyā vinītāḥ kāryagauravāt \|\| 382 \|\|*

*ūcurmadhurabhāṣiṇyā vācā te vāgmināṃ varāḥ \|*  
*draṣṭuṃ vayamihāyātāḥ śaraṇyaṃ gaṇanāyakam \|\| 383 \|\|*

*trilocanaṃ vijānīhi surakāryapracoditāḥ \|*  
*tvameva no gatistattvaṃ yathā kālānatikramaḥ \|\| 384 \|\|*

*sā prārthanaiṣā prāyeṇa pratīhāramayaḥ prabhuḥ \|*  
*ityukto munibhiḥ so 'tha gauravāttānuvāca saḥ \|\| 385 \|\|*

*savanasyāparāṃ saṃdhyāṃ snātuṃ mandākinījale \|*  
*kṣaṇena bhavitā viprās tatra drakṣyatha śūlinam \|\| 386 \|\|*

*ityuktā munayastasthus te tatkālapratīkṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*gambhīrāmbudharaṃ prāvṛṭ-tṛṣitāścātakā yathā \|\| 387 \|\|*

*tataḥ kṣaṇena niṣpanna-samādhānakriyāvidhiḥ \|*  
*vīrāsanaṃ bibhedeśo mṛgacarmanivāsitam \|\| 388 \|\|*

*tato vinīto jānubhyām avalambya mahīsthitim \|*  
*uvāca vīrako devaṃ praṇāmaikasamāśrayaḥ \|\| 389 \|\|*

*samprāptā munayaḥ sapta tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ dīptatejasaḥ \|*  
*vibho samādiśa draṣṭum avagantum ihārhasi \|*  
*te 'bruvandevakāryeṇa tava darśanalālasāḥ \|\| 390 \|\|*

*ityukto dhūrjaṭistena vīrakeṇa mahātmanā \|*  
*bhūbhaṅgasaṃjñayā teṣāṃ praveśājñāṃ dadau tadā \|\| 391 \|\|*

*mūrdhnaḥ kampena tānsarvān vīrako 'pi mahāmunīn \|*  
*ājuhāvāvidūrasthān darśanāya pinākinaḥ \|\| 392 \|\|*

*tvarābaddhārdhacūḍāste lambamānājināmbarāḥ \|*  
*viviśurvedikāṃ siddhāṃ giriśasya vibhūtibhiḥ \|\| 393 \|\|*

*baddhapāṇipuṭākṣipta-nākapuṣpotkarāstataḥ \|*  
*pinākipādaugalaṃ vandyaṃ nākanivāsinām \|\| 394 \|\|*

*tataḥ snigdhekṣitāḥ śāntā munayaḥ śūlapāṇinā \|*  
*manmathāriṃ tato hṛṣṭāḥ samaṃ tuṣṭuvurādṛtāḥ \|\| 395 \|\|*

*munaya ūcuḥ*  
*aho kṛtārthā vayameva sāṃprataṃ sureśvaro 'pyatra varo bhaviṣyati \|*  
*bhavatprasādāmalavārisekataḥ phalena kācit tapasā niujyate \|\| 396 \|\|*

*jayatyasau dhanyataro himācalas tadāśrayaṃ yasya sutā tapasyati \|*  
*sa daityarājo 'pi mahāphalodayo vimūlitāśeṣasuro hi tārakaḥ \|\| 397 \|\|*

*tvadīyamaṃśaṃ pravilokya kalmaṣāt svakaṃ śarīraṃ parimokṣyate hi yaḥ \|*  
*sa dhanyadhīrlokapitā caturmukho hariśca yatsaṃbhramavahnidīpitaḥ \|\| 398 \|\|*

*tvadaṅghriugmaṃ hṛdayena bibhrato mahābhitāpapraśamaikahetukam \|*  
*tvameva caiko vividhākṛtakriyaḥ kileti vācā vidhurair vibhāṣyate \|\| 399 \|\|*

*athādya ekastvamavādi nānyathā jagattathā nirghṛṇatāṃ tava spṛśet \|*  
*na vetsi vā duḥkhamidaṃ prajātmakaṃ vihanyate te khalu sarvataḥ kriyā \|\| 400 \|\|*

*upekṣase cej jagatāmupadravaṃ dayāmayatvaṃ tava kena kathyate \|*  
*svayogamāyāmahimāguhāśrayaṃ na vidyate nirmalabhūtigauravam \|\| 401 \|\|*

*vayaṃ ca te dhanyatarāḥ śarīriṇāṃ yadīdṛśaṃ tvāṃ pravilokayāmahe \|*  
*adarśanaṃ tena manoratho yathā prayāti sāphalyatayā manogatam \|\| 402 \|\|*

*jagadvidhānaikavidhau jaganmukhe kariṣyase 'to balabhiccarā vayam \|*  
*vinemuritthaṃ munayo visṛjya tāṃ giraṃ girīśaśrutibhūmisaṃnidhau \|\| 403 \|\|*

*ityuktā munayo jagmus tvaritāstu himācalam \|*

*menovāca*  
*yadarthaṃ duhiturjanma necchantyapi mahāphalam \|*

*aiśvaryamavagacchasva śaṃkarasya surāsuraiḥ \|*  
*ārādhyamānapādābja-yugalatvātsunirvṛtaiḥ \|\| 418 \|\|*

*yasyopayogi yadrūpaṃ sā ca tatprāptaye ciram \|*  
*ghoraṃ tapasyate bālā tena rūpeṇa nirvṛtiḥ \|\| 419 \|\|*

*tato muhūrte brāhme tu tasyāścakruḥ surastriyaḥ \|*
